title: Digital Connectivity and Household Income: Evidence from Women-Headed Households in Viet Nam
affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU), Asian Development Bank and

detail.title: Digital Connectivity and Household Income: Evidence from Women-Headed Households in Viet Nam

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 846

detail.abstract: This paper examines the effect of digital connectivity on income of women-headed households in Viet Nam. Using the Viet Nam Digital Economy Access Index and the Viet Nam Household Living Standards Survey, empirical evidence shows that increased digital connectivity significantly improves the income of women headed households. Disadvantaged groups, such as those with limited educational attainment and lower income levels, and living in rural areas, benefit more from having digital connectivity. We explore the mechanisms behind this relationship and find that digital connectivity is related to increased participation in the labor market, particularly in the services sector. This paper offers new insights into the inclusive effects of digital connectivity and provides policy recommendations for advancing digital infrastructure development.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了数字连接对越南女性户主家庭收入的影响，发现数字连接显著提升了这些家庭的收入，且对教育程度低、收入低和农村地区的弱势群体效果更明显，其机制是通过促进劳动力市场参与（尤其是服务业）实现的。
AI.research_question: 数字连接如何影响越南女性户主家庭的收入？
AI.motivation: 探讨数字连接对弱势群体（女性户主家庭）的包容性影响，填补数字鸿沟与性别不平等交叉领域的实证研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字包容理论、劳动力市场参与理论、性别与发展经济学
AI.method: 使用越南数字经济接入指数（Viet Nam Digital Economy Access Index）和越南家庭生活标准调查（VHLSS）数据，进行实证回归分析。
AI.findings: 数字连接显著提高了女性户主家庭的收入；教育程度低、收入低和农村地区的弱势女性户主家庭受益更多；机制是通过增加劳动力市场参与（尤其是服务业）实现的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了数字连接对女性户主家庭收入影响的新证据，揭示了数字包容性的边际效应递减规律（弱势群体获益更大），丰富了数字性别经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为越南及发展中国家推进数字基础设施建设、制定针对弱势女性群体的数字包容政策提供了实证依据和政策建议。

title: Leadership Behaviors and Employee Engagement During Generative AI Adoption in Engineering Organizations: Applying the LAWS-AI Framework

detail.title: Leadership Behaviors and Employee Engagement During Generative AI Adoption in Engineering Organizations: Applying the LAWS-AI Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial, professional, or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research, analysis, interpretation, or presentation of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The present work at current stage is a theoretical and conceptual framework study and does not involve human participants, patient records, experimental procedures, interviews, surveys, or identifiable personal data. Accordingly, institutional ethics approval and participant consent were not required. Future empirical validation of the LAWS-AI framework involving human participants would be conducted subject to appropriate Institutional Review Board (IRB) or ethics committee approval and informed consent procedures.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Engineering organizations invest heavily in Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) yet frequently fail to realize full value because workforce engagement weakens during transformation. This paper proposes the Leadership-Alignment-Well-being-Sustainability for Artificial Intelligence (LAWS-AI) framework to explain how leadership behaviors shape employee engagement during GenAI adoption. Three leadership theories are integrated through explicit, nonoverlapping pillar assignments: transformational leadership anchors the Leadership pillar (L), addressing motivational and identity dimensions; Situational Leadership Theory anchors the Alignment pillar (A), addressing developmental calibration; and adaptive leadership anchors the Well-being pillar (W), addressing identity renegotiation under uncertainty. The Job Demands-Resources model anchors the Sustainability pillar (S) and specifies downstream outcomes. Four empirically testable hypotheses trace a causal chain from leadership input through engagement to organizational performance. A mixed-methods sequential explanatory design specifies Phase 1 interviews (n = 15-25) to inform Phase 2 survey administration (n ≥ 300), with the survey analyzed through structural equation modeling. The reflection documents three genuine intellectual shifts and identifies three priority gaps for future inquiry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LAWS-AI框架，整合变革型领导、情境领导理论和适应性领导等三种领导理论，结合JD-R模型，解释在GenAI采用过程中领导行为如何塑造员工敬业度，并通过混合方法研究设计进行实证检验。
AI.research_question: 在生成式人工智能（GenAI）采纳过程中，领导行为如何影响员工敬业度？
AI.motivation: 工程组织在GenAI上投入大量资源，但因员工敬业度在转型过程中下降而未能充分实现价值，需要理论框架来理解和解决这一现实问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: LAWS-AI框架：变革型领导理论（领导支柱L）、情境领导理论（对齐支柱A）、适应性领导理论（福祉支柱W）、JD-R模型（可持续性支柱S）。
AI.method: 混合方法序贯解释性设计：第一阶段访谈（n=15-25）为第二阶段大规模问卷调查（n≥300）提供信息，问卷通过结构方程模型（SEM）分析。
AI.findings: 提出四个可检验的假设，构建从领导输入通过敬业度到组织绩效的因果链；记录了三个核心智力转向并识别了三个优先未来研究缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将三种领导理论（变革型、情境、适应性）通过明确、非重叠的支柱分配整合到GenAI采纳情境中，并结合JD-R模型形成完整因果链框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工程组织在GenAI转型中如何通过领导行为提升员工敬业度提供可操作的理论指导，帮助组织最大化GenAI投资价值。

title: The Multi-Jurisdiction Stablecoin Compliance Matrix: A Cross-Jurisdictional Reference Across Six Regulatory Regimes

detail.title: The Multi-Jurisdiction Stablecoin Compliance Matrix: A Cross-Jurisdictional Reference Across Six Regulatory Regimes
detail.abstract:
This Matrix is a structured cross-jurisdictional reference for legal practitioners, compliance officers, treasury professionals, and academic researchers working at the intersection of digital-asset regulation and traditional financial regulation. This v0.9.3 pre-release draft (May 18, 2026) is circulated for substantive community comment in advance of a stable v1.0 release scheduled September 2026.

Coverage spans six jurisdictions: the United States, the European Union, the United Kingdom, Singapore, Hong Kong SAR, and mainland China. Each jurisdictional entry tracks ten dimensions: regulatory authority and statutory basis; issuer pathways and eligibility; reserve and backing requirements; capital requirements; redemption mechanics; yield and interest treatment; AML/KYC framework; cross-border data treatment; distribution and offering restrictions; and implementation status and timeline. Identified interpretive uncertainties are flagged inline.

The Matrix synthesizes recent regulatory developments including the GENIUS Act (Pub. L. No. 119-27, July 2025); the proposed Digital Asset Market Clarity Act with the Tillis-Alsobrooks compromise Section 404 (Senate Banking Committee advancement May 14, 2026); the UK Cryptoasset Regulations 2026 (SI 2026/102) and the November 2025 Bank of England proposals on systemic sterling stablecoins; MiCA Article 23 and the European Banking Authority's No-Action Letter on PSD2-MiCA interplay (EBA/Op/2025/08, June 10, 2025) with the follow-up Opinion on supervisory priorities (EBA/Op/2026/01, February 12, 2026); the MAS Single-Currency Stablecoin framework and the FSMA Part 9 DTSP regime; the Hong Kong Stablecoins Ordinance (Cap. 656) and HKMA's April 10, 2026 first-license cohort (HSBC and Anchorpoint Financial Limited); and the PBOC and CAC informal guidance of October 2025 that paused PRC-connected applications in Hong Kong.

Three architectural patterns emerge from the cross-jurisdictional comparison. Pattern 1 traces the issuer-layer / intermediary-layer split and the textual hinge "solely" performs in the US framework. Pattern 2 traces the monetary-sovereignty asymmetry that prevents a single USD-anchored token from serving the European Union, Hong Kong, and mainland China at scale as a payments rail. Pattern 3 traces the parallel track of registered investment products—the Investment Company Act of 1940 and its analogues across the six jurisdictions—and applies the Reves family-resemblance test's fourth factor as a structural template for cross-border routing architectures.

The Matrix is the structural backbone for a series of doctrinal analyses. The operational US framework for distinguishing compliant routing from disguised yield under Section 404 is developed separately in Fan, Narrowing the Section 404 Prohibition: A Quantitative Framework for Distinguishing User-Initiated Routing from Disguised Yield Under the Tillis-Alsobrooks Compromise to the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, SSRN Working Paper (May 2026), https://ssrn.com/abstract=6724920.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个跨六个司法管辖区的稳定币监管矩阵（v0.9.3预发布版），从十个维度系统比较美国、欧盟、英国、新加坡、香港和中国大陆的监管框架，并提炼出三种结构模式，为后续法律分析提供骨架。
AI.research_question: 在数字资产监管与传统金融监管交叉领域，如何系统性地构建跨司法管辖区的稳定币监管参考框架？不同司法管辖区的监管架构呈现怎样的结构性模式？
AI.motivation: 随着稳定币监管在全球范围内加速推进（如GENIUS法案、MiCA、香港稳定币条例等），法律从业者、合规官和研究者需要一个结构化的跨司法管辖区参考工具，以应对日益复杂的合规要求和跨境协调问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用比较法学方法，以十个监管维度为分析框架；引入三种结构性模式分析：发行层/中介层二分法（"solely"文本铰链）、货币主权不对称性、以及注册投资产品平行轨道（Reves家族相似性测试第四因素）。
AI.method: 结构化比较法：覆盖六大司法管辖区，追踪十个监管维度（监管机构与法律基础、发行人路径与资格、储备与担保要求、资本要求、赎回机制、收益与利息处理、AML/KYC框架、跨境数据处理、分销与发行限制、实施状态与时间表），并对识别出的解释不确定性进行行内标记。
AI.findings: 提炼出三种跨司法管辖区的架构模式：模式一：美国框架中发行层/中介层的"solely"文本铰链；模式二：货币主权不对称性阻碍单一美元锚定代币在欧盟、香港和中国大陆作为支付轨道大规模运行；模式三：注册投资产品的平行轨道可适用Reves家族相似性测试第四因素作为跨境路由架构的结构模板。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了三种可推广的结构性分析模式（发行层/中介层二分法、货币主权不对称性、投资产品平行轨道），为跨司法管辖区数字资产监管的比较法学研究提供了理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律从业者、合规官、财务专业人士和学术研究者提供了一个涵盖六大司法管辖区、十个维度的结构化参考矩阵；标识了各司法管辖区解释不确定性；为v1.0稳定版发布（2026年9月）征集社区意见。

title: State Dependence of Monetary Policy During Global Supply Chain Disruptions
affiliations: Tsinghua University, , University of International Business and Economics and University of Oxford

detail.title: State Dependence of Monetary Policy During Global Supply Chain Disruptions
detail.abstract:
We study how global supply chain disruptions affect monetary policy transmission. Post-pandemic evidence indicates surging transportation costs, goods-market imbalances, and rising prices. We develop a model in which logistical bottlenecks (upstream slack coexisting with downstream shortages) steepen the aggregate supply curve. This convexity amplifies price responses to monetary policy while dampening output effects. Threshold VAR and Local Projection estimates are consistent with this mechanism: during disruptions, contractionary policy reduces prices more at smaller output cost, easing the stabilization trade-off.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了全球供应链中断如何影响货币政策的传导机制。研究发现，供应链瓶颈（上游产能过剩与下游短缺并存）会陡化总供给曲线，使货币政策的价格效应放大而产出效应减弱，从而在紧缩政策下以更小的产出成本实现价格稳定。
AI.research_question: 全球供应链中断如何影响货币政策的传导机制？
AI.motivation: 后疫情时代出现了运输成本飙升、商品市场失衡和物价上涨等现象，传统货币政策理论在此背景下可能失效，亟需重新审视供应链冲击对货币政策传导的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了一个包含物流瓶颈的模型，其中上游产能过剩与下游短缺并存导致总供给曲线变得更加陡峭（凸性增强），从而改变了货币政策冲击的传导路径。
AI.method: 理论建模（包含物流瓶颈的宏观经济模型）与实证检验（阈值向量自回归 Threshold VAR 和局部投影 Local Projection 估计方法）相结合。
AI.findings: 供应链中断期间，总供给曲线变陡，使得紧缩性货币政策在抑制价格方面效果更强，而对产出的负面影响更小，即政策制定者的"稳定权衡"得到改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将供应链物流瓶颈纳入货币政策传导分析框架，揭示了供应链凸性如何改变总供给曲线形状，进而影响货币政策的产出-通胀权衡关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为后疫情时代各国央行在供应链中断环境下制定货币政策提供了理论依据和实证参考，表明在供给瓶颈时期，紧缩政策可以更有效地控制通胀且代价更小。

title: Microeconomic Analysis of Fisheries and Aquaculture in Oman
affiliations: and Sultan Qaboos University

detail.title: Microeconomic Analysis of Fisheries and Aquaculture in Oman
detail.abstract: This research focuses on Oman's fisheries and aquaculture sector, examining market structure, the effectiveness of pricing models, and the economics of increasing export income and enhancing national food security using microeconomics theory in relation to empirical data from the "Fisheries Statistics book 2024" and other sources. The analysis reveals the coexistence of two subsystems: an oligopoly in the aquaculture and commercial fishing industries and perfect competition in artisanal fishing, which accounts for 77% of the industry. The results reveal that while total production has grown to 900,630 tons, the level of production dropped to 27 thousand tons because of powerful summer seasonal shocks. Although the aggregate demand is very elastic, there is an inherent structural inelasticity in the demand for some fish, such as Kingfish. Government measures address the "tragedy of the commons" by restricting exports and imposing fishing bans. The study recommends the strengthening of cold storages within the region to manage seasonal prices fluctuations, the use of adaptive licensing and quotas to prevent biomass exploitation, and local fish feed production through the Khazaen plant to ensure a sustainable fisheries industry.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用微观经济学理论，分析了阿曼渔业和水产养殖业的市场结构、定价模型及其对出口收入和国家粮食安全的影响。研究发现该行业存在寡头垄断（水产养殖和商业捕捞）与完全竞争（占77%的手工捕捞）并存的二元结构，总产量虽达90万吨，但夏季季节性冲击导致产量骤降至2.7万吨。尽管总需求弹性高，但某些鱼类（如王鱼）需求存在结构性缺乏弹性。政府通过限制出口和禁渔令应对"公地悲剧"。建议加强冷库设施、采用适应性许可和配额制度，以及通过本地鱼饲料生产确保行业可持续性。
AI.research_question: 阿曼渔业和水产养殖业的市场结构如何？定价模型的有效性如何？如何通过微观经济学理论增加出口收入和增强国家粮食安全？
AI.motivation: 阿曼渔业面临季节性冲击、资源过度开发（公地悲剧）以及市场结构复杂等问题，需要基于实证数据分析市场结构和定价机制，为政策制定提供依据以提升出口收入和粮食安全水平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微观经济学理论，包括市场结构理论（寡头垄断与完全竞争）、需求弹性理论、公地悲剧理论以及定价模型。
AI.method: 基于《2024年渔业统计手册》等来源的实证数据，运用微观经济学理论进行市场结构分析和定价模型有效性评估。
AI.findings: 1）行业存在二元市场结构：水产养殖和商业捕捞为寡头垄断，手工捕捞（占77%）为完全竞争；2）总产量已增长至90万吨，但夏季季节性冲击导致产量骤降至2.7万吨；3）总需求具有高弹性，但某些鱼类（如王鱼）存在结构性需求缺乏弹性；4）政府通过限制出口和禁渔令应对公地悲剧。
AI.theory_contributions: 将微观经济学中的市场结构理论（寡头垄断与完全竞争并存）和需求弹性理论应用于渔业领域的实证分析，揭示了发展中国家渔业市场中二元结构的运作机制及其对定价和资源配置的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三项政策建议：1）加强冷库建设以管理季节性价格波动；2）采用适应性许可和配额制度防止生物量过度开发；3）通过Khazaen工厂进行本地鱼饲料生产以保障渔业可持续性。

title: Ranking Venture Investors
affiliations: Stanford University - Graduate School of Business and University of Florida - Department of Finance, Insurance and Real Estate

detail.title: Ranking Venture Investors
detail.abstract: We develop a new ranking algorithm of venture capital (VC) firms and individual VC investors. Our algorithm emphasizes the importance of valuation, dilution, net profits, value add, and human capital decay. For illustration, we apply the methodology to rank the top 100 US-based individual VCs and top 100 US-based VC firms for 2023, drawing on more than 230,000 investments by over 13,000 VCs. Our rankings differ sharply from the Midas list published by Forbes: only 42 of our top 100 individual VCs appear on the 2023 Midas list, and the correlation of rankings among investors ranked in the top-100 by both lists is approximately 0.27. We attempt to replicate the Midas methodology and find significant inconsistencies that cannot be explained by methodological differences alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新的风险投资机构和个人排名算法，强调估值、稀释、净利润、增值和人力资本折旧等指标，2023年对超过13,000家风投的23万笔投资进行排名，结果与福布斯Midas榜单存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个更全面、更准确的风险投资机构和个人排名方法？
AI.motivation: 现有风险投资排名（如福布斯Midas榜单）存在方法论缺陷，过度依赖单一指标且缺乏一致性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险投资绩效评估理论、估值与稀释理论、人力资本折旧理论。
AI.method: 基于估值、稀释、净利润、增值和人力资本折旧五个维度的加权排名算法，使用23万+笔投资数据对13,000+风投进行排名。
AI.findings: 新排名与Midas榜单重叠率仅42%，排名相关系数约0.27，且Midas方法论存在无法仅由方法论差异解释的重大不一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入人力资本折旧等新维度到风投排名理论中，揭示现有排名方法论的严重缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 为LP（有限合伙人）和创业者提供更可靠的风投评估工具，推动风险投资行业评估标准的改进。

title: Credit Supply, Firms, and Earnings Inequality
affiliations: Columbia University, University of Bonn, Bavarian State Office for Statistics (Bayerisches Landesamt für Statistik) and Government of the Federal Republic of Germany - Institute for Employment Research (IAB)

detail.title: Credit Supply, Firms, and Earnings Inequality
detail.abstract:
We study the distributional consequences of monetary policy-induced credit supply in the German labor market. Firms in relationships with banks that are more exposed to the introduction of negative interest rates in 2014 experience a relative contraction in credit supply, associated with lower average wages. Within firms, initially lower-paid workers are more likely to leave employment, while initially higher-paid workers see a relative decline in wages. Between firms, wages fall by more at initially higher-paying employers. Our results suggest that credit affects the distribution of wages and employment both within and between firms.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2014年欧洲央行引入负利率政策后，通过银行信贷渠道对德国劳动力市场产生的分配效应。研究发现，与受负利率冲击更大的银行有借贷关系的企业，信贷供给相对收缩，导致平均工资下降。在企业内部，原本低薪员工更可能离职，高薪员工则面临相对工资下降；在企业之间，原本高薪企业的工资下降幅度更大。这表明信贷冲击同时影响企业间和企业内部的工资与就业分配。
AI.research_question: 货币政策引发的信贷供给冲击如何影响劳动力市场中工资与就业的分配？这种影响在企业内部（不同层级员工之间）和企业之间（不同薪酬水平企业之间）有何差异？
AI.motivation: 传统研究多关注货币政策对宏观劳动力市场的总量效应，但对其分配效应知之甚少。负利率政策这一独特自然实验为识别信贷供给冲击对劳动力市场分配结构的影响提供了机会，有助于深入理解货币政策的异质性传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信贷传导机制理论、劳动力市场搜寻与匹配理论、企业内部工资设定理论
AI.method: 利用德国企业-银行匹配数据，以2014年欧洲央行引入负利率政策作为外生冲击，采用异质性处理效应识别策略，分析银行对负利率的暴露程度差异对企业信贷供给及劳动力市场结果的因果影响。
AI.findings: （1）与受负利率冲击更大的银行合作的企业信贷供给显著收缩；（2）受冲击企业平均工资下降；（3）企业内部：低薪员工更可能离职，高薪员工相对工资下降；（4）企业之间：初始工资水平较高的企业工资下降幅度更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示了货币政策信贷渠道在企业内部和企业间的劳动力分配效应，将货币传导机制与劳动力市场异质性理论相结合，丰富了货币政策分配效应的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估非常规货币政策的分配后果提供了实证依据，提示负利率政策可能加剧劳动力市场不平等，对低技能员工和高薪企业的差异化影响值得关注。

title: A Promise Worth Keeping? Impacts of Free Community College on Degrees and Earnings
affiliations: , , University of Tennessee, Knoxville and University of Tennessee, Knoxville

detail.title: A Promise Worth Keeping? Impacts of Free Community College on Degrees and Earnings
detail.abstract:
We study Tennessee Promise, Tennessee’s tuition-free community college program, which preceded similar programs in over twenty states and multiple federal proposals. We examine how Promise affected college enrollment and early adult outcomes as the program expanded from a single-county pilot to statewide eligibility. Promise increased college enrollment by 5.4 percentage points among 19-year-olds, increased transfers from two-year to four-year schools, increased associate’s degree attainment by 2.9 percentage points among 21-year-olds, imprecisely increased bachelor’s degree attainment by age 24, and weakly increased income from age 21. We estimate that the program pays for itself under reasonable assumptions about returns to college.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究田纳西州承诺计划（免学费社区大学项目）对大学入学和早期成人结果的影响，发现该项目提高了入学率、转学率和副学士学位获得率，并在合理假设下能够自给自足。
AI.research_question: 田纳西州承诺计划（免学费社区大学项目）如何影响学生的大学入学、学位获得和早期成人经济结果？
AI.motivation: 田纳西州承诺计划是先于全美20多个州及多项联邦提案的免学费社区大学项目，评估其政策效果对其他州和联邦的类似政策制定具有重要参考价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本投资理论；教育经济学中的成本-收益分析框架。
AI.method: 利用项目从单县试点到全州推广的扩展过程，采用准实验研究方法（如双重差分法）识别因果效应。
AI.findings: （1）项目使19岁青少年大学入学率提高5.4个百分点；（2）增加了从两年制向四年制学校的转学；（3）21岁副学士学位获得率提高2.9个百分点；（4）24岁学士学位获得率有提高但不精确；（5）21岁后收入略有增加；（6）在合理的大学回报假设下，项目能够自给自足。
AI.theory_contributions: 为免费社区大学政策的效果提供了因果证据，丰富了人力资本投资理论及教育补贴政策效果的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国其他州及联邦层面的免学费社区大学政策设计提供了实证依据，表明该类政策在合理条件下具有成本效益。

title: Management of Health Care Facilities and Patient Attendance during Major Disruptions: Evidence from Kenya
affiliations: World Bank, World Bank - International Finance Corporation (IFC), World Bank - Development Research Group (DECRG), World Bank,  and The World Bank

detail.title: Management of Health Care Facilities and Patient Attendance during Major Disruptions: Evidence from Kenya
detail.abstract:
This paper measures and analyzes management practices in the Kenyan health care sector, drawing on a nationally representative survey and linked administrative data. The paper adapts the World Management Survey to measure management quality in primary health care facilities and hospitals, surveying 429 primary health care facilities and 73 hospitals. Primary health care facilities are the primary point of contact for most patients, providing treatment for common infectious diseases and chronic conditions, as well as services related to maternal and child health. Management quality is low on average, and the distribution is highly compressed. The analysis uses administrative data to test the association between the management quality and performance of primary health care facilities, measured by outpatient attendance, during a period of disruption that included the COVID-19 pandemic and a public health workers’ strike. Overall attendance fell during this period. Private facilities experienced a smaller decline than public facilities, consistent with substitution during the strike. Within the private sector, better-managed facilities showed greater resilience, driven primarily by operations management. These results underscore the role of management quality in strengthening facility-level resilience and the complementarity of public and private sectors in absorbing healthcare shocks.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用全国代表性调查和行政数据，测量了肯尼亚医疗保健行业的管理实践质量，发现管理质量普遍较低且分布集中。研究进一步分析了管理质量与基层医疗机构在疫情期间（COVID-19和医务人员罢工）表现的关系，发现私立机构中管理更好的设施更具韧性，运营管理是关键驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 肯尼亚医疗保健行业的管理质量如何？管理质量与基层医疗机构在外部冲击（疫情和罢工）下的表现有何关联？
AI.motivation: 医疗保健系统面临疫情、罢工等外部冲击时，机构的韧性至关重要。然而，管理质量在其中的作用尚不明确，尤其是在发展中国家基层医疗情境下缺乏系统性证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织管理理论、韧性理论、公私部门互补性理论
AI.method: 采用世界管理调查（WMS）工具测量肯尼亚429个基层医疗机构和73家医院的管理质量；结合行政数据，通过回归分析检验管理质量与门诊量变化之间的关联。
AI.findings: 1）管理质量总体偏低且分布高度集中；2）疫情期间整体门诊量下降；3）私立机构降幅小于公立机构，存在替代效应；4）在私立部门内部，管理质量越高的机构韧性越强，运营管理维度驱动效应最显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 将管理质量研究拓展至发展中国家基层医疗情境；揭示了管理质量在外部冲击下对组织韧性的差异化作用；提出了公私部门在医疗冲击中互补吸收的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家改善基层医疗管理实践提供了实证依据；提示政策制定者应注重提升医疗机构（尤其是公立机构）的运营管理能力以增强韧性；为公私互补的医疗应急体系设计提供了参考。

title: States as Financiers: International Lending in War and Peace
affiliations: Kiel Institute for the World Economy, National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), World Bank, Centre for Economic Policy Research (CEPR), International Monetary Fund (IMF), School of Public Affairs, Harvard University, Harvard Kennedy School (HKS), Belfer Center for Science and International Affairs (BCSIA) , Harvard University - Center for Business and Government, Peterson Institute for International Economics and Kiel Institute for the World Economy

detail.title: States as Financiers: International Lending in War and Peace
detail.abstract:
States are major international financiers, but their role is poorly understood. We study state-driven cross-border lending over two centuries using a new database covering 1.2 million official loans and grants by 134 governments and 70 multilateral institutions since 1790. We document a dual, state-contingent structure of international credit. In normal times, private creditors dominate cross-border lending. In adverse states of the world, such as wars and financial crises, official creditors step in, at times on a massive scale. These official flows are driven by great powers, are highly subsidized, and are largely absent from canonical models in international macroeconomics.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1790年以来134个政府和70个多边机构的120万笔官方贷款和赠款的新数据库，研究了过去两个世纪国家驱动的跨境贷款，揭示了国际信贷的双重、国家依存的二元结构：和平时期私人债权人主导，战争和金融危机等不利状态下官方债权人大规模介入，且这些官方流动由大国驱动、高度补贴，但被主流国际宏观经济模型忽视。
AI.research_question: 国家驱动的跨境贷款在两个世纪的历史中呈现出怎样的模式？官方信贷在什么情况下介入以及其规模和特征如何？
AI.motivation: 国家是重要的国际金融参与者，但其角色长期以来未被充分理解，且主流国际宏观经济模型忽略了官方信贷流动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重、国家依存的国际信贷结构理论（dual, state-contingent structure of international credit）
AI.method: 构建1790年至今覆盖134个政府和70个多边机构的120万笔官方贷款和赠款的新数据库，进行历史数据分析和描述性统计。
AI.findings: 1）正常时期私人债权人主导跨境贷款；2）战争和金融危机等不利状态下官方债权人大规模介入；3）官方流动由大国驱动且高度补贴；4）这些模式被主流国际宏观经济模型忽视。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了国际信贷的"双重、国家依存的二元结构"理论框架，填补了官方信贷流动在国际宏观经济理论中的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解国家在危机时期作为国际"最后贷款人"的角色提供了历史证据，对国际金融治理和政策制定具有参考意义。

title: The Limits of Targeted Hiring Subsidies: Evidence from the Work Opportunity Tax Credit
affiliations: , University of Wisconsin-Madison - Department of Economics and University of Southern California

detail.title: The Limits of Targeted Hiring Subsidies: Evidence from the Work Opportunity Tax Credit
detail.abstract:
Employer-side wage subsidies are widely used to promote employment among disadvantaged workers. We study how such subsidies translate into firm hiring behavior using the federal Work Opportunity Tax Credit, which subsidizes up to 40% of first-year wages and covers over two million hires annually. Using linked administrative data from Wisconsin and multiple quasi-experimental designs, we find consistent and precise null effects on hiring, earnings, retention, and related outcomes across designs and firm types. Original data on firm hiring practices suggest two mechanisms that can limit employer-side subsidy efficacy: perceived legal risks discourage eligibility screening and organizational frictions attenuate decision-makers’ responsiveness.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究雇主方工资补贴（如联邦工作机会税收抵免）对弱势群体就业的实际效果，发现这类补贴对企业的招聘、薪资、留任等行为没有显著影响，原因在于企业感知的法律风险和组织摩擦削弱了补贴的有效性。
AI.research_question: 雇主方工资补贴如何转化为企业的招聘行为？即联邦工作机会税收抵免（Work Opportunity Tax Credit）是否有效促进了弱势群体的就业？
AI.motivation: 雇主方工资补贴被广泛用于促进弱势群体就业，但其实际效果缺乏充分的因果证据。该补贴覆盖每年超过200万次招聘，补贴高达第一年工资的40%，因此评估其有效性具有重要的政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动经济学中的工资补贴理论、企业招聘行为理论、组织行为学中的组织摩擦理论。
AI.method: 使用威斯康星州的关联行政数据，结合多种准实验设计（quasi-experimental designs）进行因果推断，并收集企业招聘实践的原始数据进行机制分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现，雇主方工资补贴对企业的招聘、薪资、留任等相关结果呈现出一致且精确的零效应；两种机制解释了补贴效果有限的原因：1）企业感知的法律风险阻碍了资格筛选；2）组织摩擦削弱了决策者对补贴的反应。
AI.theory_contributions: 更新了关于雇主方工资补贴有效性的理论认知，揭示了补贴传导过程中的组织行为障碍，丰富了劳动政策与组织行为交叉领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：仅靠雇主方工资补贴可能不足以促进弱势群体就业，需结合降低企业法律风险、简化操作流程等配套措施；对企业人力资源管理实践也具有参考价值。

title: The (Lack of) Efficacy of Social Belonging and Growth Mindset Interventions Among College Students
affiliations: Queen’s University , University of Toronto - Department of Economics and New York University (NYU) - Department of Economics

detail.title: The (Lack of) Efficacy of Social Belonging and Growth Mindset Interventions Among College Students
detail.abstract:
Using four large-scale experiments across two major Canadian universities, we experimentally evaluate the effects of growth mindset and social belonging interventions on student outcomes. In a sample of nearly 12,000 students, we find no immediate or dynamic effects on student grades and no effect on persistence through university. We further combine survey and administrative data with machine learning methods to explore treatment effect heterogeneity, finding no evidence of meaningful variation in treatment effects across student subgroups. Despite the recent promise of these light-touch interventions, our findings indicate further research is required to identify the contexts in which their benefits generalize.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过加拿大两所大学的四项大规模实验（近12,000名学生样本），发现成长心态和社会归属感干预对学生成绩和大学持续就读率没有显著影响，且机器学习异质性分析也未发现任何学生亚组存在有效效果。
AI.research_question: 成长心态干预和社会归属感干预能否显著改善大学生的学业成绩和持续就读率？
AI.motivation: 近年来，轻触式心理干预（如成长心态和社会归属感干预）被广泛宣传为提升学生学业表现的有效低成本手段，但缺乏大规模、多场景的严格实验验证。本研究旨在通过大样本、多实验设计检验其效果的可推广性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成长心态理论（Carol Dweck）：认为智力是可发展的信念会影响学习动机和韧性；社会归属感理论：认为学生在校的归属感不足会导致学业脱落。两种干预均属于"轻触式"（light-touch）社会心理干预。
AI.method: 四项大规模随机对照实验（field experiments），样本量近12,000名学生，来自加拿大两所主要大学。结合调查数据与管理数据，使用机器学习方法（如因果森林等）进行异质性处理效应分析。
AI.findings: 1）两类干预对学生成绩均无即时或动态效应；2）对大学持续就读率无显著影响；3）机器学习异质性分析未发现任何学生亚组存在有意义的处理效应差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 对成长心态和社会归属感干预的"普适有效性"假设提出了重大挑战，表明这些理论驱动的干预措施的效果可能高度依赖情境，而非广泛适用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者和高校管理者提供了重要警示：轻触式心理干预并非"万能药"，在推广前需要更严谨地甄别有效实施情境，避免资源浪费。

title: The Educational Impacts of School Phone Bans: Evidence from Brazil
affiliations: University of Zurich - Department of Economics, University of São Paulo (USP), School of Economics, Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) - Sao Paulo School of Economics and Stanford University

detail.title: The Educational Impacts of School Phone Bans: Evidence from Brazil
detail.abstract:
Concerns about negative impacts of student phone use have led to calls around the world for tighter restrictions on phones in schools. This paper evaluates the impact of a 2023 policy that banned non-pedagogical uses of phones within schools in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. To isolate the causal effects of the policy, we contrast middle schools that already had strict rules on phone use prior to the policy ("control schools'') to similar schools that did not have strict rules ("treatment schools''), before and after the ban. While restrictions were imperfectly implemented both before and after the ban, we show that in-school phone use fell substantially in treatment schools relative to control. We then show that test scores, which were trending similarly in the two groups prior to the ban, improved by 0.06 s.d. in treatment schools relative to control.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了2023年里约热内卢禁止学生在校内使用手机的政策效果，发现该政策显著减少了校内手机使用，并提高了学生考试成绩约0.06个标准差。
AI.research_question: 禁止学生在校内使用手机的政策是否能够减少手机使用并提高学业成绩？
AI.motivation: 全球范围内对学生手机使用负面影响的担忧日益增加，多个国家和地区的学校正在考虑或已实施更严格的手机限制政策，但缺乏严谨的因果效应评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政策干预的准实验设计，利用双重差分法识别因果关系。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法，对比政策实施前已实施严格手机限制的学校（控制组）与未实施严格限制的学校（处理组），在政策前后的变化。
AI.findings: （1）政策实施后，处理组学校的校内手机使用显著下降；（2）处理组学生的考试成绩相对于控制组提高了0.06个标准差。
AI.theory_contributions: 为手机禁令对学业成绩的因果效应提供了来自发展中国家的证据，丰富了关于教育政策与学生注意力分配的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和教育管理者提供了实证依据，支持在学校实施手机禁令以改善学生学业表现。

title: Has the United States Bent the Health Care Cost Curve?
affiliations: Harvard University and Harvard Business School

detail.title: Has the United States Bent the Health Care Cost Curve?
detail.abstract:
In 2024, medical spending as a share of GDP was 15% below forecasts made in 2010 and only marginally higher than in 2010. Relative to expectations, the savings were nearly $1 trillion in 2024. In light of this prolonged period of slower growth, we ask the question: has the United States bent the health care cost curve? We start with a model of medical spending that incorporates both the development of new technologies and the equilibrium use of those technologies. Technology development and incentives around its use may add to or subtract from spending growth. We then examine the drivers of the spending slowdown empirically. We attribute slower medical spending growth to five factors: the development of technologies that simultaneously improve health and lower cost; long-run supply elasticities that exceed short-run elasticities; improvements in population health; reimbursement changes that reduce demand and make demand more price elastic; and reductions in the rate of price increases, likely driven by some of these same demand factors. Because these cost slowing mechanisms are expanding over time, we conclude that the United States has bent the health care cost curve, though not as much as it could be or will need to be bent.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美国是否已成功扭转医疗成本曲线。研究发现，2024年美国医疗支出占GDP比重比2010年的预测低15%，节省了近1万亿美元。作者构建了包含技术开发和均衡使用的医疗支出模型，并将增长放缓归因于五个因素：低成本高效益技术、长期供给弹性大于短期、人口健康改善、医保报销改革降低需求并提高价格弹性、以及价格增速下降。结论是美国确实扭转了医疗成本曲线，但程度尚不充分。
AI.research_question: 美国是否已经成功扭转（bend）医疗成本曲线？即医疗支出增速是否已持续放缓？
AI.motivation: 2024年美国医疗支出占GDP比重比2010年预测低15%，节省近1万亿美元，这一长期增长放缓现象值得深入探究其成因和可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了包含新技术开发和均衡使用的医疗支出模型，认为技术发展及其使用激励既可能增加也可能减少支出增长。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与实证分析相结合，对医疗支出增长放缓的驱动因素进行归因分析。
AI.findings: 医疗支出增长放缓的五个驱动因素：低成本高效益的技术发展；长期供给弹性超过短期；人口健康改善；医保报销改革降低需求并提高价格弹性；价格增速下降。由于这些机制正在扩大，美国已部分但非充分地扭转了医疗成本曲线。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了同时考虑技术开发和技术使用激励的医疗支出理论模型，为理解医疗成本长期趋势提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了降低医疗成本的具体路径：鼓励低成本高效益技术、改善人口健康、改革报销机制等，对美国医疗政策具有重要参考价值。

title: Industrial Concentration, Property Values, and Municipal Bond Spreads
affiliations: University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business

detail.title: Industrial Concentration, Property Values, and Municipal Bond Spreads
detail.abstract:
This paper shows that the industrial composition of a city's local economy affects its municipal borrowing costs. In a panel of 1,177 U.S. cities from 2005 to 2022, greater sectoral concentration magnifies default risk and raises bond spreads, especially for cities dominated by industries associated with low property values. Instrumental variables exploiting national sector-employment trends and regional house-price variation support a causal interpretation. A calibrated model of city default suggests that the observed spread effect understates the gross risk created by concentration, because higher concentration can generate agglomeration benefits that reduce spreads, especially for high-property-value cities.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 城市产业集聚度越高，市政借款成本越高，但高房产价值城市可通过集聚效应部分抵消风险溢价。
AI.research_question: 城市的产业结构（产业集中度）如何影响其市政借款成本？
AI.motivation: 已有文献关注企业层面的多元化与融资成本，但城市层面的产业集中度对市政债券市场的影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业集中度→违约风险→债券利差；集聚经济效应可部分缓解风险。
AI.method: 面板数据（2005-2022, 1,177个美国城市）；工具变量法（利用全国行业就业趋势与区域房价变动）；校准的城市违约模型。
AI.findings: 产业集中度显著放大违约风险并推高债券利差，尤其当城市主导产业与低房产价值相关时；但高房产价值城市可从集聚效应中获益，降低利差。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了产业专业化对市政信用的双重效应（风险效应 vs. 集聚效应），校准模型表明观测到的利差低估了集中度的真实风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市产业多元化政策、市政债券定价及投资者风险评估提供实证依据。

title: Designing More Informative Tests: Separating Execution from Recognition
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Designing More Informative Tests: Separating Execution from Recognition
detail.abstract:
Tests are widely used to measure ability, yet performance on a test often reflects more than the ability to execute assigned tasks. It also reflects the ability to recognize which tasks are worth attempting, how they should be prioritized, and how effort should be allocated under uncertainty. This paper studies how tests can be designed to separate these capabilities. We model a test as a sequential decision problem. Tasks differ in difficulty, their ordering is uncertain, and examinees may acquire costly information about that ordering before choosing how to proceed. The testing environment is the informational structure surrounding the realized test: in particular, the examinee's beliefs about how task difficulty has been arranged. Performance is therefore generated by an optimal recognition–execution policy, not by execution skill alone. The analysis delivers two negative results. First, even in the simplest two-task environment, a single score exhibits dimensional collapse: distinct combinations of execution skill and recognition capability generate identical expected scores. Second, with three tasks, the relationship between capabilities and scores becomes environment-dependent: changing beliefs about task ordering can change which actions are considered and how capabilities translate into performance. These results imply that standard scores are not generally informative enough to separate the capabilities that generate performance. This matters because scores are used to summarize what individuals can do and to guide downstream decisions about placement, training, and instruction. If a test does not separately reveal execution and recognition, it provides limited guidance about which capability is strong, which is weak, and where improvement should be directed. We then show how more informative tests can be designed. Under a simple communicability constraint, two canonical environments—ordered and randomized tests—induce distinct relationships between capabilities and scores. In an ordered test, recognition is suppressed and performance isolates execution. In a randomized test, recognition is activated and performance reflects both execution and recognition. Observing performance across these environments separates capabilities that are confounded in any single score. The paper reframes testing as a problem of informational design: tests should be designed not only to record performance, but to reveal the distinct capabilities that generate it.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何设计测试以区分执行能力（完成任务的能力）和识别能力（判断任务优先级、分配努力的能力）。通过将测试建模为序贯决策问题，发现单一分数无法区分这两种能力，但通过有序测试（抑制识别）和随机测试（激活识别）的组合可以分离它们。
AI.research_question: 如何设计测试才能有效区分执行能力（task execution skill）和识别能力（recognition capability）？
AI.motivation: 标准测试分数反映的是执行能力和识别能力的混合产物，但现有测试设计无法区分这两种能力。由于分数被用于评估个体能力和指导后续决策（如分班、培训、教学指导），如果无法分离这两种能力，测试提供的指导将十分有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将测试建模为序贯决策问题（sequential decision problem）：任务难度不同、顺序不确定，被试可以获取关于顺序的昂贵信息后再行动。测试环境被视为围绕已实现测试的信息结构（即被试对任务难度排列方式的信念）。表现由最优的"识别-执行"策略（recognition-execution policy）生成，而非单纯执行技能。
AI.method: 理论建模与分析：构建两任务和三任务的序贯决策测试模型，分析不同能力组合下的分数特征，并通过有序环境与随机环境的对比检验信息设计的效果。
AI.findings: 1. 两任务环境下，单一分数存在"维度坍缩"（dimensional collapse）：不同的执行能力与识别能力组合可产生相同的期望分数。2. 三任务环境下，能力与分数的关系变得环境依赖：改变对任务顺序的信念会改变哪些行动被考虑以及能力如何转化为表现。3. 在有序测试（ordered test）中，识别被抑制，表现孤立地反映执行能力；在随机测试（randomized test）中，识别被激活，表现同时反映执行能力和识别能力。结合两种环境的观测可分离单一分数中混淆的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将测试重新定义为信息设计问题（informational design），拓展了测试设计的理论视角。2. 证明了标准测试分数的维度坍缩问题，揭示了单一测试无法分离能力的理论根源。3. 提出了通过对比有序环境与随机环境来分离能力的理论方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育测试、人员选拔、职业能力评估等实践领域提供了设计更"信息丰富"的测试的方法论指导，帮助决策者识别个体是执行能力不足还是识别能力不足，从而更有针对性地进行培训、分班和教学干预。

title: Attorney Value-Added and Racial Disparities in the Criminal Justice System
affiliations: , University of Texas at Austin and Texas A&M University

detail.title: Attorney Value-Added and Racial Disparities in the Criminal Justice System
detail.abstract:
Racial disparities permeate the criminal justice system, yet indigent defense attorneys remain understudied despite representing 80% of defendants. Using quasi-randomly court-appointed attorneys in a large Texas county, we show that higher-quality attorneys are less experienced and attended lower-quality law schools. Low-quality representation disproportionately harms Black defendants: a one-standard-deviation increase in quality raises Black dismissal rates nearly twice that of Whites’ (7.1% versus 3.9%), and top-10% representation increases dismissals by 12–17% and reduces jail by 13-22% relative to Whites. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest if half of court-appointed attorneys were top-10% quality, the racial gap in jail sentencing would decline by 11%.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用德州一个县 quasi-random 指定的公设辩护人数据，发现高质量律师（经验较少、法学院排名较低）能显著提高案件驳回率、减少监禁刑期，且对黑人被告的正面影响约为白人的两倍。若一半公设辩护人达到前10%质量，黑白监禁差距可缩小11%。
AI.research_question: 公设辩护人（indigent defense attorneys）质量差异如何影响刑事司法结果中的种族不平等？
AI.motivation: 种族歧视在刑事司法系统中普遍存在，但占被告80%的公设辩护人群体却被严重低估。以往文献多关注检察官、法官的偏见，对律师质量差异及其种族异质性效应缺乏因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 律师质量对案件结果的影响机制（如辩护策略、谈判能力）；种族歧视的差异效应（相同质量的律师对不同种族被告产生不同效果，或因系统性偏见导致低质量律师对少数族裔伤害更大）。
AI.method: 利用德州某县 quasi-random（准随机）的法庭指定律师分配作为自然实验；采用线性回归、工具变量等方法估计律师质量（以案件结果衡量）对驳回率和监禁刑期的因果效应，并比较种族异质性。
AI.findings: 1）高质量律师经验更少、来自低排名法学院；2）律师质量每提高一个标准差，黑人被告驳回率提高7.1%，白人被告提高3.9%；3）前10%质量律师使黑人驳回率比白人高12-17%，监禁刑期低13-22%；4）若一半公设辩护人达到前10%质量，黑白监禁差距可缩小11%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供因果证据表明公设辩护人质量差异是刑事司法种族不平等的重要来源；揭示了“质量-种族交互效应”（相同质量改善对黑人更为有利），丰富了对制度性种族主义的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改善公设辩护人制度、缩小刑事司法种族差距提供政策依据：投资公共辩护资源（尤其是提高低质量律师水平）可以有效缓解种族不平等，而并非仅需针对检察官或法官的偏见干预。

title: Unlocking Mortgage Lock-In: Equilibrium Effects in a Spatial Housing Ladder Model
affiliations: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, University of Pennsylvania - Finance Department and INSEAD - Finance

detail.title: Unlocking Mortgage Lock-In: Equilibrium Effects in a Spatial Housing Ladder Model
detail.abstract:
Mortgage borrowers are "locked in": forgoing moves to hold on to low rates. Lock-in reduces both housing supply, through households who do not sell, and demand, through households who do not buy elsewhere, evidenced by a 40% drop in U.S. existing home sales between 2022 and 2024. We show that mortgage lock-in raises net housing demand: missing downsizers stay in larger homes, particularly in expensive areas, demanding more housing and offsetting a third of the aggregate house price decline caused by higher rates. Using individual-level mortgage data, we provide causal evidence that lock-in disproportionately reduces moves down the housing ladder. We design a spatial housing ladder model with long-term mortgages, which generates a distribution of locked-in rates and a causal effect on mobility consistent with the data, and use it to study the equilibrium effects of lock-in. A temporary rate hike causes lock-in, increasing aggregate house prices by 4.4% and rents by 1.5% relative to a counterfactual without lock-in, while mortgage borrowers' mobility falls by 25%. A $10k tax credit to starter-home sellers modestly increases mobility but raises trade-up home prices. We estimate a cost of $650k per marginal move, indicating that demand-based housing policies are poorly targeted responses to lock-in in our model.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Cheapflation Cycles

detail.title: Cheapflation Cycles
detail.abstract:
We document a new source of fluctuations in inflation inequality. When the cost of upstream inputs rises, varieties within a product category tend to have similar absolute price increases. However, the same absolute price increase constitutes a larger percentage change for low-price products, resulting in excess inflation at the low end (“cheapflation”). Since low-income households tend to buy lower-priced varieties, the inflation rates they face are disproportionately sensitive to upstream costs. Using data on food-at-home purchases, we show that this mechanism generates cycles in inflation inequality and excessive volatility in inflation for low-income households relative to high-income households. This channel parsimoniously accounts for observed fluctuations in inflation inequality over time, including surges in cheapflation and inflation inequality during both the Great Recession and the 2021–2023 post-pandemic inflation. Official statistics mask these within-category differences in inflation and thus understate the differences in inflation experienced by low- and high-income households by 70–90 percent. We provide evidence that this mechanism applies to a range of consumption categories beyond food at home. The same mechanism also leads to systematic differences in inflation across cities and import price inflation across countries in response to nationwide and global cost shocks.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了“廉价通胀”（cheapflation）现象：上游成本上升时，低价商品因绝对价格涨幅相同但百分比涨幅更大，导致低收入家庭面临更高通胀率，官方统计低估了不同收入家庭间的通胀差异达70-90%。
AI.research_question: 上游成本冲击如何通过产品类别内部的差异化定价影响通胀不平等？
AI.motivation: 已有文献关注总体通胀，但忽视了同一产品类别内部不同价格档次商品对通胀不平等的贡献。本文试图量化这一机制对低收入家庭通胀率的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于上游成本传导、消费者异质性（不同收入群体选择不同价格档次的商品）、以及绝对价格与百分比价格变化的非对称性。
AI.method: 利用家庭食品消费购买数据（food-at-home purchases），分析上游成本变化对不同价格档次商品价格涨幅的影响，并测算不同收入家庭面临的实际通胀率差异。
AI.findings: （1）上游成本上升时，低价商品因绝对涨幅相同导致百分比涨幅更高（“廉价通胀”）； （2）低收入家庭更倾向购买低价商品，因此面临更高通胀； （3）这一机制解释了经济衰退和疫情后通胀期通胀不平等的飙升； （4）官方通胀统计低估了高低收入家庭间通胀差异的70-90%； （5）该机制同样适用于其他消费类别、城市间通胀差异及跨国进口价格通胀。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统提出“廉价通胀”概念，将上游成本冲击、产品内价格差异与家庭异质性纳入统一的通胀不平等分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示官方通胀统计的严重偏差，为政策制定者调整通胀监测指标、设计针对性补贴和通胀救助政策提供依据。

title: The Human Capital Production Function: New Estimates and Implications for Labor Supply and Taxes
affiliations: University of New South Wales, Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School, University of Minnesota and University of New South Wales

detail.title: The Human Capital Production Function: New Estimates and Implications for Labor Supply and Taxes
detail.abstract:
This paper estimates a learning-by-doing human-capital production function in which hours affect both current productivity and future human capital. We show that the standard Ben-Porath specification is weakly identified: its objective function is nearly flat along a ridge in parameter space, undermining conventional inference. We develop a flexible sieve alternative that is well-identified, and estimate a concave hours technology using PSID data. Embedding this technology in a life-cycle model, we find very small prime-age labor-supply responses to temporary wage shocks. Despite these low elasticities, optimal labor-income taxes are flat because they distort both current labor supply and future human-capital accumulation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文估计了一个干中学的人力资本生产函数，发现标准的Ben-Porath模型存在弱识别问题，开发了灵活的筛分替代方法，并估计出凹性的工作时间技术。将该技术嵌入生命周期模型后发现，壮年劳动力对临时工资冲击的供给反应很小，但最优劳动所得税率仍是平坦的。
AI.research_question: 如何正确估计干中学模式下工作时间对当前生产率和未来人力资本的双重影响？标准Ben-Porath模型的识别问题如何解决？
AI.motivation: 标准Ben-Porath人力资本生产函数存在弱识别问题（目标函数在参数空间沿脊线近乎平坦），导致传统推断不可靠。
AI.theoretical_framework: 干中学（Learning-by-doing）人力资本生产函数；Ben-Porath模型；生命周期模型；最优税收理论。
AI.method: 使用PSID数据估计灵活筛分（sieve）替代模型，然后将估计的技术嵌入生命周期模型进行校准分析。
AI.findings: 1. Ben-Porath模型弱识别；2. 工作时间技术呈凹性；3. 壮年劳动力对临时工资冲击的供给弹性非常小；4. 尽管弹性低，最优劳动所得税率仍是平坦的（因为税收同时扭曲当前劳动供给和未来人力资本积累）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了标准Ben-Porath模型的弱识别问题；2. 提出了更可靠的筛分估计方法；3. 在统一框架下同时分析了劳动供给弹性和最优税收设计。
AI.practical_contributions: 为最优劳动所得税政策设计提供了新洞察：即使劳动供给弹性很低，税收仍需保持平坦以避免双重扭曲（当前劳动与未来人力资本投资）。

title: Comparative Advantage and Openness under Global Fragmentation: Lessons from the Past 65 Years
affiliations: University of Southern California - Department of Economics, Portland State University - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Comparative Advantage and Openness under Global Fragmentation: Lessons from the Past 65 Years
detail.abstract:
This paper asks why openness has been such a strong catalyst for catch-up growth in some regions or countries, while in others openness has been followed by stalled convergence, divergence, or stagnation. We conclude that “openness” in today’s geoeconomically fragmented world is much more than trade intensity or trade integration. Positioning in trade networks, trade fundamentals, human capital, institutional capacity and stability matters for the potential for trade-induced productivity gains. We explore the global heterogeneity across continents between 1960 and 2024, unbalanced panel of up to 145 economies per year and estimate a growth equation using a dynamic approach for countries and years. We build a baseline equation relating real GDP growth to lagged income and growth. We complement the traditional drivers of growth by contorting for positionings variables the world economy: a proxy for economic integration measuring the number of regional trade arrangements ratified by each economy, a commodity dependence indicator; metrics related to export networks geoeconomic vulnerability (GeoV). measure country’s export position with geopolitically distant partnerships; geoeconomic connectivity (GeoC) measuring the degree that trade relationships are across greater spectrum of geopolitics. The GeoC measures external “connectors” positioning that may counterbalance costs of geoeconomic fragmentation by securing access to greeter variety of markets and resources. Notably, the Geoeconomic linkages add an important element of “positioning,” indicating that the more “geopolitically” connected is a country, the greater are the investment-growth links. A greater diverse positioning of countries’ economies improves their capacity to transform investment into output in a more diversified setting. This also indicate a lesser dependent growth on “momentum” by countries’ economy, pointing to a greater shock-absorption capacity, confirming the benefits of diversified structure for growth from investments facing pressures from fragmentation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨为何开放在某些地区促进追赶式增长，而在其他地区却导致增长停滞或分化。研究发现，在地缘经济碎片化的当下，"开放"远不止贸易强度，还包括贸易网络定位、人力资本、制度能力等。通过分析1960-2024年145个经济体的面板数据，发现地缘经济连通性（GeoC）和地缘经济脆弱性（GeoV）等定位变量显著影响增长，多元化的地缘经济连接能增强投资-增长关系和抗冲击能力。
AI.research_question: 为什么开放在某些地区和国家是追赶式增长的强劲催化剂，而在其他地区却伴随着增长趋同停滞、分化或停滞？
AI.motivation: 在当今地缘经济碎片化的世界中，"开放"的内涵已远超贸易强度或贸易一体化程度，需要更全面的框架来理解开放对经济增长的异质性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 增长理论、贸易网络理论、地缘经济定位理论；核心概念包括经济一体化（区域贸易协定数量）、商品依赖度、出口网络地缘经济脆弱性（GeoV）、地缘经济连通性（GeoC）。
AI.method: 使用1960-2024年横跨各大洲、每年最多145个经济体的非平衡面板数据，采用动态方法估计增长方程，在传统增长驱动因素基础上加入地缘经济定位变量。
AI.findings: 地缘经济联系增加了重要的"定位"要素：国家的地缘政治连接越广泛，投资-增长关联越强。经济体的多元化定位能提升将投资转化为产出的能力，减少对"动量"型增长的依赖，增强吸收冲击的能力，证实了多元化结构在碎片化压力下对投资驱动型增长的益处。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"定位"概念引入开放与增长的理论框架，区分了地缘经济脆弱性（GeoV）与地缘经济连通性（GeoC）两个新维度，丰富了关于贸易网络、制度能力和增长关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了超越传统贸易开放度指标的实证依据，指出在碎片化时代，通过多元化地缘经济连接来增强抗冲击能力和投资效率的重要性。

title: From People’s War to People’s Rule: Rebel Governance and the Foundations of Inclusive Democracy
affiliations: Government of Nepal, London School of Economics, Yale University - Economic Growth Center, Stanford University,  and

detail.title: From People’s War to People’s Rule: Rebel Governance and the Foundations of Inclusive Democracy
detail.abstract:
How does wartime rebel governance shape post-conflict institutions? We study this in Nepal, where the Maoist People's War (1996–2006) dismantled a 240-year caste-based monarchy and ended with Maoists entering democratic politics. During the conflict, Maoists established sub-national “People’s Governments” that administered justice, collected taxes, and delivered local services. Using a spatial regression-discontinuity design, we show that exposure to People's Governments increased political knowledge and participation especially among historically marginalized indigenous groups (Janajatis). Exposure also reshaped party institutions and inter-party competition: candidate-selection committees in more exposed areas have 26 percent more Janajati members who, drawing on novel implicit-attitude data, exhibit less pro-upper caste bias. Non-Maoist parties' Janajati nomination rates nearly double in fully exposed areas, consistent with competition for newly mobilized voters. Nearly two decades on, local governments in exposed areas score 0.2–0.3 standard deviations higher on state capacity indices and receive 13% more in conditional federal grants. These findings show that when rebel groups enter competitive democratic politics, wartime governance institutions can — through citizen mobilization, party gatekeeping, and cross-party competition — enable a more inclusive and capable post-war state.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究尼泊尔毛主义人民战争（1996-2006）期间的战时叛军治理如何影响战后制度。研究发现，暴露于毛主义"人民政权"的地区，公民政治知识和参与显著提升，尤其惠及原住民（Janajatis）等历史上被边缘化群体；政党制度被重塑，候选人遴选委员会中原住民成员增加26%，且其内隐偏见降低；非毛主义政党原住民提名率近乎翻倍；近二十年后，暴露地区地方政府能力指数提高0.2-0.3个标准差，获得联邦拨款增加13%。研究表明，当叛军进入民主政治竞争时，战时治理可通过公民动员、政党守门和跨党派竞争，催生更具包容性和能力的战后国家。
AI.research_question: 战时叛军治理如何塑造战后制度？
AI.motivation: 尼泊尔毛主义人民战争推翻了长达240年的种姓君主制，叛军最终进入民主政治。这一独特历史背景为研究战时治理的长期制度效应提供了自然实验条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公民政治动员理论、政党守门人理论、跨党派竞争理论
AI.method: 空间回归断点设计（Spatial Regression-Discontinuity Design）；结合隐式态度测试数据（Implicit-Attitude Data）
AI.findings: （1）暴露于人民政权提高了政治知识和参与，尤其惠及原住民群体；（2）候选人遴选委员会中原住民成员增加26%，且内隐偏见降低；（3）非毛主义政党原住民提名率近乎翻倍；（4）近二十年后，暴露地区地方政府能力指数提高0.2-0.3个标准差，联邦拨款增加13%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了战时叛军治理通过公民动员、政党内部改革和跨党派竞争三条机制，实现战后制度包容性和能力提升的理论路径，拓展了叛军治理与制度变迁的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为冲突后国家建设和制度设计提供重要启示：战时基层治理实践若与民主政治相衔接，可成为促进边缘群体政治融入和提升国家能力的积极力量。

title: Preference for Explainable AI
affiliations: Harvard University

detail.title: Preference for Explainable AI
detail.abstract:
Participants acted as loan officers deciding whether to approve real $10,000-loans issued by a private U.S. lender using an AI’s default-risk predictions. When explanations revealed that the AI penalized non-White or female borrowers, participants were more likely to override the AI’s profit-maximizing recommendation. When their bonuses depended on repayment, however, they sought predictions but avoided explanations, consistent with willful ignorance; this effect faded when explanations were framed as purely financial or demographics were hidden. A secondary experiment reveals a novel bias: participants failed to reason contingently and undervalued explanations even when these complemented private information and improved decision accuracy.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验发现，当AI的信用贷款决策模型显示对非白人或女性借款人有偏见时，贷款官员更倾向于推翻AI的利润最大化建议；但当自身奖金与还款挂钩时，他们主动回避了解释（故意无知），除非解释仅涉及财务信息或隐藏了人口统计学特征。此外，参与者存在一种新偏见：未能进行条件推理，低估了能补充私人信息并提高决策准确性的解释价值。
AI.research_question: 贷款官员在AI辅助决策中，如何权衡利润最大化、算法解释与社会公平？尤其是当面临个人经济激励时，他们会主动选择对算法偏见的"故意无知"吗？
AI.motivation: 探究现实金融场景中，当AI的利润最大化建议与公平原则冲突时，人类决策者的行为反应，以及经济激励机制如何影响其获取算法解释的意愿。
AI.theoretical_framework: 故意无知（willful ignorance）理论、算法厌恶与算法信任、条件推理（contingent reasoning）偏见。
AI.method: 实验研究：参与者扮演贷款官员，对实际10,000美元贷款申请进行审批，借助AI的违约风险预测及解释信息，操纵奖金激励、解释框架和人口统计学特征可见性等变量。
AI.findings: 1）当AI解释暴露种族/性别偏见时，参与者倾向于推翻AI建议；2）但当奖金取决于还款时，参与者主动寻求预测却回避解释（故意无知），且该效应在解释纯财务化或隐藏人口特征后消失；3）参与者存在条件推理偏差，低估了互补性解释提升决策准确性的价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）揭示了"故意无知"在AI辅助决策中的新表现形式；2）发现了决策者面对算法偏见时的条件推理失败这一新偏见；3）拓展了算法公平性与经济激励交互作用的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为金融机构设计AI决策系统提供警示：激励机制可能诱导决策者主动回避公平信息；2）建议将人口统计学特征从算法输入中移除或仅提供纯财务解释，以减少道德风险；3）提示AI辅助决策系统应设计为强制披露偏见信息，防止"故意无知"损害公平性。

title: A Tale of Two Market Returns: The Broad Market Factor and The Idiosyncratic Financial Factor
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas - Banking Supervision, University of Notre Dame and MIT Sloan School of Management

detail.title: A Tale of Two Market Returns: The Broad Market Factor and The Idiosyncratic Financial Factor
detail.abstract:
We construct a Broad Market Factor (BMF), which is a proxy for the value-weighted equity return on all firms in the US economy (public and private). The BMF differs from the standard Value-weighted Market Factor (VMF), which reflects the value-weighted equity return on public firms. We define the difference between the VMF and the BMF to be the Idiosyncratic Financial Factor (IFF). The IFF carries no risk premium and is uncorrelated with all macroeconomic proxies for investor marginal utility we consider. CAPM betas and, consequently, discount rates are underestimated when measured with respect to the VMF compared to the BMF for most portfolios. Size factors become redundant and the size anomaly is resolved when the VMF is replaced by the BMF in standard factor models. The intertemporal risk-return relation is substantially stronger when one replaces the VMF with the BMF. The unifying explanation for these results is that the IFF adds unpriced risk to the VMF, distorting both cross-sectional and time-series estimates of exposure to priced market risk.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含所有美国企业（上市和私营）的广义市场因子（BMF），发现传统仅基于上市公司的价值加权市场因子（VMF）包含非定价的特质性金融因子（IFF），导致CAPM贝塔被低估、规模因子冗余、风险-回报关系被弱化等一系列问题。
AI.research_question: 如果使用包含所有美国企业（包括私营企业）的广义市场因子（BMF）代替仅包含上市公司的标准价值加权市场因子（VMF），对资产定价的横截面和时间序列估计会产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 标准市场因子仅包含上市公司，忽略了私营企业这一占美国经济重要部分的市场板块，可能导致对系统性风险暴露的系统性低估。
AI.theoretical_framework: CAPM、市场因子模型、特质性风险与定价、跨期风险-回报关系
AI.method: 构建包含所有美国企业（上市和私营）的广义市场因子（BMF），将其与标准价值加权市场因子（VMF）进行比较，定义两者之差为特质性金融因子（IFF），并通过实证分析检验IFF的风险溢价、相关性、以及BMF对贝塔估计、规模因子和跨期风险-回报关系的影响。
AI.findings: （1）IFF不携带风险溢价，与所有宏观经济边际效用代理变量不相关；（2）使用VMF会导致大多数组合的CAPM贝塔和贴现率被低估；（3）用BMF替代VMF后，规模因子变得冗余，规模异象消失；（4）跨期风险-回报关系在使用BMF时显著增强。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了标准市场因子因包含非定价的特质性成分而系统性扭曲了对市场风险暴露的估计，为规模异象、风险-回报关系弱化等现象提供了统一解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议资产定价研究和实务中使用更全面的广义市场因子（BMF）以更准确地估计系统性风险暴露和贴现率。

title: Will The University Endowment Tax Slow Scientific Progress? Evidence from Elite Economics PhD Programs
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics, University of Passau and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Will The University Endowment Tax Slow Scientific Progress? Evidence from Elite Economics PhD Programs
detail.abstract:
The 2025 university endowment tax hike and other sources of financial pressure may lead the schools that train the most prolific economics researchers to reduce graduate enrollment. Will this affect long-run research output? We use a novel sample of MIT Economics PhD program applicants to estimate the research value-added of eight elite schools. Our estimates mitigate selection bias by controlling for MIT admissions committee rankings—a remarkably strong predictor of long-run research success—and for applicant aspirations as revealed by their application portfolios. While rank controls substantially reduce estimated gaps between elite and non-elite graduates, large differences in value-added remain. Graduates of high-tax and other top-eight schools produce 60-75% more impact-adjusted publications than do comparable graduates from non-top-eight US schools. The elite-school advantage is especially pronounced for top five journal publications. Differences in research success within the elite tier, however, are relatively modest. The out-performance of elite-school PhDs does not appear to be explained by editorial connections or peer effects in elite programs.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用麻省理工学院经济学博士项目申请者的独特样本，估计八所精英学校的研究价值增值。通过控制MIT招生委员会排名（预测长期研究成功的强大指标）和申请者的抱负，发现精英学校毕业生在影响调整后的发表数量上比非精英学校毕业生高60-75%，但精英层级内部差异较小，且精英优势不能用编辑关系或同伴效应解释。
AI.research_question: 2025年大学捐赠税上调及其他财务压力是否会导致培养最多经济学研究人员的学校减少研究生招生，进而影响长期研究产出？精英经济学博士项目相比非精英项目的研究价值增值有多大？
AI.motivation: 政策层面：2025年大学捐赠税上调可能迫使顶尖项目缩减招生规模，需要评估这种缩减对长期研究产出的影响。方法论层面：以往研究难以区分精英学校的选择效应与培养效应，本文通过独特的MIT申请者数据和强大的控制变量来缓解选择偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论（学校通过培养提高学生研究能力）；信号/筛选理论（精英学校仅筛选出更有天赋的学生）；选择偏差与因果识别。
AI.method: 使用MIT经济学博士项目申请者的独特样本；控制MIT招生委员会的排名（作为预测长期研究成功的强大指标）和申请者通过申请组合揭示的抱负；比较精英学校（高税收及其他前八名）与非精英学校毕业生的研究产出。
AI.findings: 1. 排名控制显著缩小了精英与非精英毕业生之间的估计差距，但仍有较大差异。2. 高税收及其他前八名学校毕业生比非前八名美国学校毕业生多产出60-75%的影响调整后发表。3. 精英学校的优势在顶级期刊（前五名期刊）发表上尤为突出。4. 精英层级内部的研究成功差异相对较小。5. 精英学校博士生的优异表现不能用编辑关系或精英项目中的同伴效应来解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了关于精英经济学博士项目研究价值增值的因果性估计，揭示了选择效应与培养效应的相对重要性，表明精英学校确实有显著的培养价值而非仅仅是筛选功能。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估捐赠税上调对研究产出的潜在影响提供依据；为经济学博士申请者选择项目提供参考；为大学资源配置决策提供实证支持。

title: Improving the Energy Efficiency of Communicant Autonomous Vehicles in Signal-Free Urban Networks at a Macroscopic Scale
affiliations: Kennesaw State University and Cornell University

detail.title: Improving the Energy Efficiency of Communicant Autonomous Vehicles in Signal-Free Urban Networks at a Macroscopic Scale
detail.abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence and wireless communication technologies in communicant autonomous vehicles (CAVs) enables coordinating the movement of CAV platoons at signal-free intersections. The capacity of signal-free intersections can be significantly improved by adjusting macroscopic traffic variables; however, the resulting improvement in the capacity does not necessarily have a positive impact on the energy consumption of CAVs. In this research, we develop an analytical model to enhance energy efficiency by optimizing macroscopic traffic variables in signal-free networks. To this end, we adopt a macroscopic modeling approach to estimate expected capacity by accounting for the stochasticity resulting from operational error in synchronizing the arrival and departure of consecutive platoons in crossing directions at intersections. We also develop a macrolevel analytical model to estimate expected energy loss during the acceleration/deceleration maneuver required for resynchronization at intersections as a function of synchronization success probability. We then maximize energy efficiency by minimizing expected energy loss and simultaneously maximizing expected capacity in a biobjective optimization framework. We solve the energy efficiency problem using an analytical approach to derive a closed-from solution for the optimal traffic speed and the length of the marginal gap between the passage of consecutive platoons in crossing directions through intersections for a (general) normal distribution of the operational error. To analyze energy efficiency at a large scale, we extend the analytical model to the network level using the Macroscopic Fundamental Diagram (MFD) concept. The results of our two-ring simulation model indicate the accuracy of the proposed analytical model in estimating the macroscopic relationship between the expected energy loss at intersections and the vehicular density in signal-free networks. Our numerical results also show that optimizing the marginal gap length and speed at intersessions can improve energy efficiency by 31% at the cost of a 16% decrease in maximum capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个解析模型，通过在无信号交叉口优化宏观交通变量（车速和边际间隙长度），在牺牲部分通行能力的情况下显著提升网联自动驾驶车辆（CAV）编队的能效，最高可提升31%能效，同时通行能力仅下降16%。
AI.research_question: 如何在无信号交叉口网络中，通过优化宏观交通变量来提升CAV编队的能效？
AI.motivation: 无信号交叉口通过调整宏观交通变量可显著提升通行能力，但通行能力的提升并不一定会对CAV的能耗产生正面影响，因此需要在通行能力与能耗之间进行权衡优化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观交通建模方法；Macroscopic Fundamental Diagram (MFD) 概念；双目标优化框架（最小化预期能量损失与最大化预期通行能力）。
AI.method: 建立解析模型：1）考虑编队到达与离开同步操作误差的随机性，估计预期通行能力；2）建立宏层面解析模型，以同步成功概率的函数形式估计加减速重同步的预期能量损失；3）构建双目标优化框架，推导出最优车速和边际间隙长度的闭式解；4）利用MFD扩展至网络层面；5）通过双环仿真模型验证模型准确性。
AI.findings: 1）所提出的解析模型能准确估计无信号网络中交叉口预期能量损失与车辆密度之间的宏观关系；2）优化边际间隙长度和车速可在牺牲16%最大通行能力的代价下，提升31%的能效。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将宏观交通变量优化与CAV编队能效分析相结合，并推导出考虑操作误差随机性的最优解闭式表达式；将分析模型通过MFD扩展至网络层面，实现了大规模能效分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为无信号交叉口的CAV编队管理提供了可操作的参数优化策略（车速与边际间隙），在通行能力适度牺牲的前提下显著提升能效，有助于实现交通系统绿色可持续发展。

title: Enhancing the Battery Life of Communicant Autonomous Vehicles at Signal-Free Intersections in Large Scale
affiliations: Kennesaw State University and Kennesaw State University

detail.title: Enhancing the Battery Life of Communicant Autonomous Vehicles at Signal-Free Intersections in Large Scale
detail.abstract: This research aims to enhance the battery life of communicant autonomous vehicles (CAVs) coordinated to pass through signal-free intersections with no interruption by adjusting the macroscopic traffic variables. To this end, we develop an analytical model for the battery-capacity loss of CAV platoons at intersections. We account for the stochasticity in synchronizing the arrival and departure of consecutive platoons in the crossing directions and formulate the average batterycapacity loss rate as a function of the expected cycle length. The analytical results of this research show that the battery-capacity loss at intersections can be mitigated by reducing the network speed and increasing the size of the platoons and the length of the marginal gap between the passage of consecutive platoons to improve the synchronization success probability. However, the impact of such improvement on the intersection capacity is not necessarily positive. Thus, we use the proposed analytical model to balance the tradeoff between the battery-capacity loss rate and the intersection capacity at a macroscopic scale by optimizing the platoon size, traffic speed, and marginal gap length. The numerical results of the research also show that adjusting the macroscopic traffic variables can improve CAVs' battery life by 27.6% at the cost of a 3.5% reduction from the maximum capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过调整宏观交通变量（网络速度、车队规模、边际间隙长度），在信号交叉口协调通信自动驾驶车辆（CAVs）车队通行，以延长电池寿命，同时平衡交叉口通行能力。数值结果表明，电池寿命可提升27.6%，但通行能力下降3.5%。
AI.research_question: 如何通过调整宏观交通变量，在保障信号交叉口通行能力的前提下，延长通信自动驾驶车辆（CAVs）车队的电池寿命？
AI.motivation: CAVs在无信号交叉口的协调通行中，频繁的启停和同步等待会导致显著的电池容量损失，现有研究缺乏从宏观交通变量角度对电池寿命进行建模和优化的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 电池容量损失分析模型（考虑车队到达与离开同步的随机性）；期望周期长度与平均电池容量损失率的函数关系；通行能力与电池寿命的权衡优化框架。
AI.method: 建立解析模型，将电池容量损失率表达为期望周期长度的函数；通过优化车队规模、交通速度和边际间隙长度，在宏观尺度上权衡电池容量损失率与交叉口通行能力。
AI.findings: 降低网络速度、增加车队规模、延长边际间隙长度可提高同步成功概率，从而减轻电池容量损失；但这些措施可能降低通行能力；通过优化可实现电池寿命提升27.6%，通行能力仅下降3.5%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次建立了CAVs车队在无信号交叉口通行中的电池容量损失解析模型，并将宏观交通变量与电池寿命、通行能力之间的关系形式化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智能交通系统提供了可操作的宏观交通参数调节策略，在不显著牺牲通行效率的前提下有效延长CAVs电池寿命，指导实际交叉口调度与能源管理。

title: Reprogramming Capitalism: Purpose-Bound Money, Computational Governance, and the Future of  Political Economy

detail.title: Reprogramming Capitalism: Purpose-Bound Money, Computational Governance, and the Future of  Political Economy

keywords: and the Future of Political Economy

detail.abstract:
This study develops a theoretical framework for layered monetary systems operating through Purpose-Bound Currency (PoC) architectures. It argues that generalized fungible money, while historically effective for industrial-era coordination, structurally transmits financial instability, speculative volatility, and inflationary pressures into capability-generating sectors such as healthcare, education, housing, and nutrition.
The paper proposes a differentiated monetary architecture in which selected domains of socially foundational consumption operate through purpose-bound monetary layers partially insulated from speculative financial circulation. By embedding institutional constraints directly into monetary circulation, PoC systems potentially stabilize capability formation while attenuating inflationary and financial-instability transmission mechanisms.
Integrating macroeconomics, monetary theory, financial instability theory, capability theory, computational governance, and systems analysis, the study develops dynamic models of segmented monetary circulation, cybernetic stabilization, programmable credit allocation, institutional learning, and computational coordination. It further argues that advances in computation, artificial intelligence, and real-time informational systems fundamentally expand the feasible frontier of institutional coordination beyond the generalized monetary architectures of industrial capitalism.
The paper concludes that programmable monetary systems may represent not merely a monetary innovation, but part of a broader transition from industrial market civilization toward computationally coordinated political-economic systems centered on capability stabilization, adaptive governance, and differentiated institutional coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于目的绑定货币（PoC）的分层货币体系理论框架，认为通用可替代货币会将金融不稳定和通胀传导至基础民生领域，而植入制度约束的PoC架构能够隔离投机性资金流动、稳定能力形成，并标志着从工业市场经济向计算化协调治理体系的转型。
AI.research_question: 分层货币体系如何通过目的绑定货币（PoC）架构解决通用可替代货币向医疗、教育、住房等能力生成部门传导金融不稳定、投机波动和通胀压力的问题？
AI.motivation: 通用可替代货币虽在工业时代有效协调经济，但其结构性特征会导致金融不稳定和通胀压力向基础民生领域传导，危害能力形成。因此需要探索一种差异化的货币架构来保护社会基础消费领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了宏观经济学、货币理论、金融不稳定理论、能力理论（Capability Theory）、计算治理（Computational Governance）和系统分析，构建了分段货币流通、控制论稳定、可编程信贷分配、制度学习和计算化协调的动态模型。
AI.method: 理论构建与动态模型分析，综合多学科视角进行系统建模。
AI.findings: 1. 通用可替代货币会结构性地将金融不稳定和通胀传导至能力形成部门；2. PoC系统通过在货币流通中嵌入制度约束，可部分隔离投机性金融循环，稳定能力形成；3. 计算、人工智能和实时信息系统的发展拓展了超越通用货币体制的制度协调可行边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了分层货币体系理论，将能力理论与货币设计结合，提出了货币制度作为治理工具的新视角，拓展了可编程货币的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗、教育、住房等基础民生领域设计抗通胀、抗投机的新型货币机制提供了理论依据，对央行数字货币（CBDC）和可编程货币的政策设计具有指导意义。

title: Effect of Change Orders on a Construction Worksite
affiliations: National Taiwan University and

detail.title: Effect of Change Orders on a Construction Worksite
detail.abstract: Change orders are essential tools in construction that address modifications to the scope, design, or budget of a project. They offer a formalized method of managing unforeseen circumstances, client requests, and regulatory changes. This essay explores the role of change orders on construction sites, outlining their goals, objectives, and impact, both positive and negative. It also examines the scope of change orders and provides best practices for managing them effectively. Understanding these aspects is critical to maintaining efficient, cost-effective, and high-quality construction projects. Change orders became necessary as construction projects grew in complexity, requiring a more structured way to manage unforeseen challenges, evolving client needs, and unforeseen site conditions. Their introduction helped prevent disputes, budget overruns, and delays, allowing construction teams to adapt and move forward despite obstacles. The goals of change orders include maintaining flexibility in project execution, managing costs and timelines, ensuring compliance with updated standards, and improving the overall quality of the finished project. By formally documenting and approving changes, stakeholders are able to maintain transparency, and the final product is more likely to meet client expectations and industry standards. The scope of change orders covers any change to the initial contract, from design alterations to modifications in schedule or cost. These changes are often necessary due to site conditions, regulatory adjustments, or the discovery of flaws in the original design. However, these modifications can have both positive and negative effects on the project. While change orders allow for flexibility, they can also disrupt the worksite, increase costs, and introduce confusion among stakeholders. Delays and uncertainties can arise if changes are not carefully evaluated and communicated, impacting the overall project timeline and budget. The do's and don'ts of managing change orders provide a framework for ensuring they are handled effectively. Key practices include documenting all changes, securing formal approval, and evaluating their financial and schedule impacts. It is equally important to avoid rushing the process, implementing changes without proper approval, or neglecting the necessary communication with all team members. A structured approach to change orders helps prevent unnecessary disruptions and ensures that the project continues on track. In conclusion, while change orders are an essential aspect of construction management, they require careful oversight to prevent negative outcomes. By following best practices, the construction team can handle changes efficiently and ensure the project's success.

AI.tldr: 本文系统探讨了建筑行业变更指令的定义、目标、范围、影响及管理最佳实践，强调变更指令是应对项目复杂性、管理不确定性、维持成本与进度控制的关键工具，但需通过规范流程避免负面影响。
AI.research_question: 变更指令在建筑项目管理中扮演什么角色？如何有效管理变更指令以平衡其正面灵活性与负面风险？
AI.motivation: 随着建筑项目日益复杂，缺乏结构化变更管理机制会导致纠纷、预算超支和工期延误，因此需要系统理解变更指令的作用与管理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 项目变更管理理论、合同管理理论、利益相关者沟通理论、风险控制理论。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析（本文为概念性综述文章，未采用实证研究方法）。
AI.findings: 变更指令具有双重影响：正面包括保持灵活性、控制成本与工期、确保合规性、提升质量；负面影响包括干扰现场作业、增加成本、引发利益相关者混淆、导致延误。最佳实践包括：记录所有变更、获得正式批准、评估财务与工期影响、避免未经批准的变更和沟通不畅。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了变更指令在建筑管理中的角色与影响，构建了从目标、范围到正负面效应及管理框架的完整分析逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为建筑项目管理人员提供了清晰的变更指令管理指南，包括"该做与不该做"的具体实践建议，有助于减少项目风险、提升执行效率。

title: Features of the Energy Policy of the Italian Republic at the Present Stage

detail.title: Features of the Energy Policy of the Italian Republic at the Present Stage

publicationDetails.detailsText: XI Annual International Scientific Conference of Young Scientists "Current Issues of World Politics", collection of articles, Moscow, Diplomatic Academy, Pp. 170-180. (In Russian).

detail.abstract: The article is devoted to the study of the energy policy of the Italian Republic in the context of the modern transformation of the world order. The article identifies the reasons for the need to adapt Italy to new energy realities, the decisions of the Italian leadership to ensure the energy security of the state in new conditions and also presents the prospects for the development of the energy sector of the Italian Republic. Special attention is paid to identifying the main trends in the evolution of Russian-Italian energy cooperation. The relevance of this study is due to the fact that the European Union, having sided with Ukraine in the conflict with Russia, imposed unprecedented sanctions against the Russian Federation after February 24, 2022, intending to force Moscow to change its foreign policy line. The main blow fell on energy cooperation, which is traditionally one of the key sectors of Russian-European trade. Nevertheless, the restrictions of the European Union had a significant impact on the integration association itself, as they led to a global increase in fossil fuel prices and energy savings in the member states themselves. In particular, Italy, within the framework of the new EU paradigm, was also forced to rebuild its logistics chains and diversify the national energy balance.

title:
Symbolic Form, Field, and Behaviour Change: Reconstructing Cassirer, Lewin, Bourdieu and the Behaviour Change Wheel

A Theoretical-Operational Bridge from Symbolic Object Construction to Ontology-Grounded Action-Point Localisation
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title:
Symbolic Form, Field, and Behaviour Change: Reconstructing Cassirer, Lewin, Bourdieu and the Behaviour Change Wheel

A Theoretical-Operational Bridge from Symbolic Object Construction to Ontology-Grounded Action-Point Localisation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests and no personal or institutional relationships that could have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it did not involve human participants, patients, animals, clinical intervention, or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
Behaviour change design requires more than identifying determinants and selecting intervention functions. A behavioural target is not a neutral object waiting to be modified. It is symbolically constructed, dynamically positioned within a field of forces, and socially reproduced through practice, capital and legitimacy. Existing operational frameworks such as the Behaviour Change Wheel, COM-B, TDF and BCIO provide powerful tools for structuring intervention design and specification, but their categories can be deepened by reconstructing the theoretical conditions under which behaviour becomes meaningful, forceful, legitimate and transferable.

This article develops such a reconstruction through Ernst Cassirer, Kurt Lewin and Pierre Bourdieu. Cassirer explains how behavioural objects are symbolically constructed through relational concepts, signs, representation and symbolic forms. Lewin explains how such objects acquire valence, force, tension and direction within a life space. Bourdieu explains how practices are socially reproduced through habitus, capital, doxa, field position and symbolic power. These three layers show that behaviour is not merely an observable act, but a symbolic-field-social practice.

The article then connects this theoretical reconstruction to the Behaviour Change Wheel as an operational design grammar. COM-B is interpreted as a compressed diagnostic model of physical capability, psychological capability, physical opportunity, social opportunity, reflective motivation, automatic motivation and behaviour. TDF is treated as an expanded determinant map; intervention functions are interpreted as operations on meaning, field and practice; policy categories are interpreted as institutional field operations; and APEASE is treated as an admissibility filter for intervention design.

Finally, the article connects this design grammar to BCIO/BPMS-DREFS as an ontology-operational specification route. The thirteen modules — BCT, Behaviour, Population, Mechanisms of Action, Mode of Delivery, Setting, Source, Style of Delivery, Dose, Reach, Engagement, Fidelity and Schedule — are treated as a modular coordinate grid for specifying intervention architecture and diagnosing structural non-achievement. BPMS describes the constructive architecture of an intervention, while DREFS diagnoses why an intervention may fail through Dose, Reach, Engagement, Fidelity and Schedule. The resulting model treats behaviour change not as a direct movement from theory to recommendation, but as a structured route from symbolic object construction through field dynamics and social practice to ontology-grounded action-point localisation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过卡西尔、勒温、布迪厄三位理论家，重构行为改变设计的理论基础，将行为视为符号性建构、场域中的动态力场以及社会再生产实践，并系统连接BCW、COM-B、TDF、BCIO等操作框架，提出从符号对象建构、场域动力学到社会实践的完整设计路线。
AI.research_question: 如何通过符号学、场域理论和社会实践理论深化现有行为改变设计框架（如BCW、COM-B、TDF、BCIO）的理论基础？
AI.motivation: 现有行为改变设计框架（如行为改变轮）提供了强大的操作工具，但对行为目标的理论建构深度不足：行为不是等待被修改的中立对象，而是符号性地被建构、动态地定位于力场之中、并通过实践、资本和合法性被社会性地再生产。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卡西尔的符号形式哲学（关系概念、符号、表征、符号形式）；勒温的生命空间与场论（效价、力、张力、方向）；布迪厄的实践理论（惯习、资本、信念场、场域位置、符号权力）。三层框架：符号性建构 → 场域动力学 → 社会实践再生产。
AI.method: 理论重构与框架整合。将三位理论家的概念体系与行为改变轮（BCW）、COM-B模型、TDF（理论域框架）、BCIO/BPMS-DREFS进行系统性对接。
AI.findings: (1) 行为是符号-场域-社会三层建构的复合对象；(2) COM-B可被解读为压缩诊断模型，TDF为扩展决定因素地图；(3) 干预功能可被解读为对意义、场域和实践的操作，政策类别为制度性场域操作；(4) BCIO的13个模块可作为干预架构的模块化坐标网格，BPMS描述建构架构，DREFS诊断干预失败原因（剂量、覆盖、参与、保真度、进度）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为行为改变设计提供了深层理论根基：将行为从可观察的简单行动重新定义为符号性建构的对象、场域中的动力要素、社会实践的再生产产物，从而深化了BCW等操作框架的理论前提。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一条从符号对象建构→场域动力学→社会实践→本体论定位行动点的结构化设计路线，为干预设计者提供了更系统的诊断与设计思路，尤其是通过DREFS框架诊断干预失败的五个结构性维度。
