AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了VBP政策下处方替代行为的存在及其机制，丰富了医保谈判政策效果评估的理论文献，为交错DiD方法在政策评估中的应用提供了实证案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了VBP政策可能带来非预期处方替代行为的证据，强调了加强监管对抑制替代行为的重要性，并对不同级别医院的差异化影响提出了管理建议。

title: Power, Property Rights, and the Dynamics of Local Wealth Appropriation
affiliations: Georgetown University - Department of Economics, Georgetown University - Department of Economics and Georgetown University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Power, Property Rights, and the Dynamics of Local Wealth Appropriation
detail.abstract: This paper examines the dynamic connections between local wealth inequality and the local politics of property rights within a federal system. We model a jurisdiction comprising a politically dominant in-group and a marginalized out-group. At each date, the jurisdiction tries to redistribute claims on productive assets. The out-group can legally challenge any changes to the status quo by appealing to its due process rights of possession (ROP). Nevertheless, the jurisdiction exploits weaknesses in the legal system to systematically redistribute property claims away from the out-group and toward the in-group. It combines takings and zoning restrictions with the leveraging of public assets to deter legal challenges. We examine how this leverage varies across time and depends on status quo effects and primacy of certain assets under the ROP. Our results highlight the role of local political economy as a source of systemic wealth disparities in the U.S.

AI.tldr: 本文研究联邦制下地方财富不平等与地方产权政治之间的动态关系，揭示了本地政治经济如何通过产权再分配机制加剧系统性财富差距。
AI.research_question: 地方财富不平等与地方产权政治之间存在怎样的动态联系？地方司法管辖区如何利用法律体系弱点进行系统性产权再分配？
AI.motivation: 美国存在持续的系统性财富差距，但地方政治经济作为这一差距的来源尚未得到充分研究。本文旨在揭示地方层面的产权政治如何成为财富不平等的重要驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦制下的产权政治理论、群体间政治经济学（内群体与外群体）、产权占有权（ROP）法律框架、现状效应理论。
AI.method: 构建动态理论模型，分析一个由政治上主导的内群体和被边缘化的外群体组成的司法管辖区，考察其在法律约束下的产权再分配行为。
AI.findings: 地方司法管辖区通过征收、分区限制以及公共资产杠杆化等策略，系统性地将产权从外群体向内群体转移；这种杠杆化程度随时间变化，并受到现状效应和产权占有权下某些资产优先性的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了地方政治经济作为美国系统性财富差距来源的理论机制；将产权政治与群体间财富不平等动态联系起来；拓展了对联邦制下地方司法管辖区策略性利用法律漏洞的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国持续存在的种族和群体间财富差距提供了地方政治层面的解释；对产权法律改革和司法保护机制具有政策启示。

title: Firm-Worker Matches: Experience or Inspection Goods?
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University, New York University (NYU) and New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Firm-Worker Matches: Experience or Inspection Goods?
detail.abstract:
We propose a novel empirical strategy to infer the extent to which firm-worker matches are inspection or experience goods. We argue that the informative content of the signals that firms and workers receive about the productivity of their match before entering an employment relationship can be inferred from the gaps between the separation rates of workers hired from unemployment, employment at low-tenure jobs, and employment at high-tenure jobs. We implement the strategy using German administrative data. We find that, before entering an employment relationship, a firm and a worker receive a signal that reduces the variance of their beliefs about the productivity of the match by 67%. The informative content of the signal varies according to the gender and the education of the worker, and it has increased over time. If matches were pure inspection goods, labor productivity would be 1.5% higher, and output 2% higher. If matches were pure experience goods, labor productivity would be 2% lower, and output 4% lower.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出新实证策略，通过分析来自失业、低任期和长任期企业的员工离职率差距，推断企业与员工匹配属于"检验商品"还是"经验商品"。利用德国行政数据发现，雇佣前双方收到的信号能将匹配生产率信念方差降低67%，且该信号的信息含量因性别、教育程度和时期而异。若匹配为纯检验商品，劳动生产率可提高1.5%，产出提高2%；若为纯经验商品，则分别降低2%和4%。
AI.research_question: 企业与员工之间的工作匹配在多大程度上属于检验商品（雇佣前可评估）还是经验商品（雇佣后才能评估）？
AI.motivation: 传统劳动经济学将匹配质量视为事前可观测（检验商品）或事后才可观测（经验商品），但缺乏识别两者混合程度的实证方法。作者希望量化雇佣前信号的信息含量，以理解劳动力市场信息摩擦的程度及其经济后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作匹配的检验商品-经验商品连续光谱理论；信号提取与信念更新模型；基于离职率差异推断事前信息含量的识别策略。
AI.method: 构建理论模型推导不同雇佣来源（失业、低任期就业、高任期就业）工人的离职率差异，反推雇佣前信号的信息含量；使用德国社会保陂关联面板数据（行政数据）进行实证估计。
AI.findings: 雇佣前信号将匹配生产率信念方差降低67%；信息含量因工人性别、教育程度而异；信息含量随时间增加；若为纯检验商品，劳动生产率+1.5%、产出+2%；若为纯经验商品，劳动生产率-2%、产出-4%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出可操作的实证策略来量化工作匹配的信息结构（检验vs.经验商品的连续程度）；将离散的二分法拓展为连续度量指标；为信息摩擦对劳动力市场效率的影响提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为劳动力市场政策（如降低信息不对称的干预措施）提供量化依据；估计了信息不完全造成的产出损失（最高可达4%），为改善劳动力匹配效率的投资提供了收益估算。

title: Directed Technical Change in the Space Economy: Growth, Spillovers, and Orbital Fragility
affiliations: University of Naples Parthenope, University of Naples Parthenope, University of Naples Parthenope, University of Napoli Parthenope and

detail.title: Directed Technical Change in the Space Economy: Growth, Spillovers, and Orbital Fragility
detail.abstract: This paper studies directed innovation in a dynamic space economy where orbital space is a productive but congestible commons. Space services raise aggregate productivity, while orbital debris increases collision risk and weakens the long-run value of space infrastructure. Innovation can be directed toward orbit-intensive technologies or toward orbit-preserving technologies. We solve a finite-horizon policy problem in which a planner chooses the path of preserving research and an orbital-use tax, and we compute the preserving-research subsidy required to decentralize the optimal allocation. The results show that the optimal transition operates mainly through the innovation margin. Redirecting scientists toward orbit-preserving research raises the relative productivity of preserving technologies, reduces collision risk and debris accumulation, and supports higher long-run output. The orbital-use tax is inactive in the benchmark calibration but becomes relevant when the welfare cost of debris is high. The findings suggest that sustainable growth in the space economy requires policies that not only regulate current orbital use, but also redirect technological change toward preserving the orbital environment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了动态空间经济中针对轨道拥堵和碎片问题的定向创新，发现最优政策主要通过引导科学家转向轨道保护型研究来实现可持续增长，而非单纯靠轨道使用税。
AI.research_question: 在轨道空间作为生产性但拥堵的公共资源的动态经济中，如何通过定向创新和政策工具实现空间经济的可持续增长？
AI.motivation: 轨道空间日益拥挤，空间碎片增加碰撞风险，威胁空间基础设施的长期价值，现有研究缺乏对空间经济中创新方向的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态空间经济模型、定向创新理论、公共资源管理理论、最优政策设计
AI.method: 构建有限时域政策问题模型，由规划者选择轨道保护型研究的路径和轨道使用税，并计算去中心化最优配置所需的保护型研究补贴。
AI.findings: 最优转型主要通过创新渠道实现；引导科学家转向轨道保护型研究可提高保护技术的相对生产率、降低碰撞风险和碎片积累、支撑更高的长期产出；轨道使用税在基准校准中无效，但在碎片福利成本高时变得重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 将定向创新理论引入空间经济分析，揭示了创新方向而非仅使用规制在管理公共资源中的关键作用，拓展了拥堵公共品管理的研究视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为空间经济可持续发展提供政策启示：需要同时监管当前轨道使用和引导技术变革向保护轨道环境的方向发展，而非仅依赖使用税。

title: Space Economy under Monetary Tightening: A DSGE Analysis
affiliations: University of Naples Parthenope, University of Naples Parthenope, University of Naples Parthenope, University of Naples Parthenope and Department of Political Science

detail.title: Space Economy under Monetary Tightening: A DSGE Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of the New Space Economy has renewed interest in the macroeconomic implications of aerospace investment and its interaction with financial and monetary conditions. Although existing research highlights the role of space activities in generating technological spillovers and long-run productivity gains, limited attention has been devoted to how monetary policy affects the transmission and effectiveness of these investments. This issue is particularly relevant because the aerospace sector is highly capital intensive and strongly dependent on financing conditions and interest-rate dynamics. To address this gap, we extend the endogenous-growth DSGE framework of Corrado et al.(2023) by incorporating monetary-policy transmission and aerospace-sector spillovers. We analyze three scenarios: an expansionary space-investment shock, a restrictive monetary-policy shock, and a joint shock combining both dynamics. The results reveal a strong interaction between monetary conditions and aerospace activity. While space-investment shocks stimulate technological spillovers and long-run growth potential, restrictive monetary policy weakens aggregate demand and delays these positive effects. In the jointshock scenario, monetary tightening dominates short-run dynamics, temporarily offsetting the benefits of space investment. Overall, the findings suggest that the macroeconomic effectiveness of space investment critically depends on the prevailing monetary regime and financial conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文在新凯恩斯动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）框架中嵌入货币传导机制和航天部门溢出效应，发现货币政策条件对航天投资的宏观经济有效性具有关键调节作用：紧缩性货币政策会削弱航天投资带来的技术溢出和长期增长潜力，在联合冲击情景下货币政策主导短期动态，暂时抵消航天投资的收益。
AI.research_question: 货币政策如何影响航天投资的宏观传导和有效性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽关注航天活动的技术溢出和长期生产率收益，但很少关注货币政策如何影响这些投资的传导效果，而航天部门高度资本密集型且依赖融资条件和利率动态，使得这一问题尤为关键。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生增长DSGE模型，拓展自Corrado et al.(2023)，纳入货币政策传导机制和航天部门溢出效应。
AI.method: 构建包含货币政策传导和航天部门溢出效应的内生增长DSGE模型，分析三种情景：扩张性航天投资冲击、紧缩性货币政策冲击、以及两者的联合冲击。
AI.findings: （1）航天投资冲击刺激技术溢出和长期增长潜力；（2）紧缩性货币政策削弱总需求并延迟航天投资的正面效应；（3）联合冲击下，货币紧缩主导短期动态，暂时抵消航天投资的好处；（4）航天投资的宏观有效性关键取决于当时的货币体制和金融条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 将货币政策传导机制引入航天经济学的DSGE分析框架，揭示了货币条件与航天投资之间的强烈交互作用，弥补了现有文献对货币政策角色的缺失。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供参考：航天投资的宏观经济效果并非独立存在，而是依赖于货币政策和金融环境，在制定航天产业政策时需协调货币政策立场。

title: The Optimal Use of AI in Financial Regulation
affiliations: Yale School of Management and Stanford University

detail.title: The Optimal Use of AI in Financial Regulation
detail.abstract:
We study whether AI methods applied to large-scale portfolio holdings data can improve macroprudential financial regulation. We build a graph-based deep learning model tailored to security-level data on the holdings of financial intermediaries. The architecture incorporates economic priors and learns latent representations of both assets and investors from the network structure of portfolio positions. Applied to the universe of non-bank financial intermediaries, covering nearly $40 trillion in wealth, the model substantially outperforms existing approaches in out-of-sample forecasts of intermediary trading behavior, including in crisis episodes. The model has more than ten times the explanatory power for the cross-sectional variation in asset returns during stress events compared to traditional approaches, and it outperforms existing systemic risk metrics at the institution level. Its learned representations show that the holdings network encodes rich, economically interpretable information about fire- sale vulnerability. The architecture is fully inductive, producing informative estimates even when entire asset classes or investors are withheld from training. We embed our empirical approach into a macroprudential optimal policy framework to formalize why these objects matter for policy and welfare. We show that even in an equilibrium environment subject to the Lucas critique, the predictive information from the model improves welfare by sharpening the cross-sectional targeting of policy interventions, and we demonstrate a complementarity between prediction and structural knowledge.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于图神经网络的深度学习模型，利用金融中介的大规模资产组合持有数据来预测交易行为、解释资产回报，并为宏观审慎监管提供政策优化框架。模型在非银行金融中介（覆盖约40万亿美元财富）的数据上表现显著优于传统方法。
AI.research_question: AI方法应用于大规模资产组合持有数据能否改进宏观审慎金融监管？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观审慎监管方法在预测金融中介交易行为（尤其是危机时期）和识别系统性风险方面存在局限，而大规模资产组合数据中蕴含的网络结构信息未被充分利用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图深度学习、资产组合网络理论、系统性风险理论、宏观审慎最优政策框架、卢卡斯批判下的均衡分析
AI.method: 基于图神经网络的深度学习模型，结合经济先验知识，从资产与投资者的网络结构中学习潜在表征。模型具有归纳学习能力，可对未训练的资产类别或投资者进行预测。
AI.findings: 1）模型在非银行金融中介交易行为预测上远超现有方法，包括危机时期；2）对压力时期资产回报截面变异的解释力是传统方法的10倍以上；3）在机构层面优于现有系统性风险指标；4）持有网络编码了关于火线抛售脆弱性的丰富经济信息；5）即使在均衡环境中，模型的预测信息也能通过改善政策干预的跨截面瞄准来提高福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 将图深度学习引入宏观审慎监管领域；证明了预测信息与结构知识之间存在互补性；将实证方法嵌入最优政策框架中，为金融网络的宏观审慎政策设计提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可落地的大规模金融监管工具，能更精准识别系统性风险机构和资产；为政策制定者提供跨截面定向干预的决策支持，提升危机应对效率。

title: Assessment of the impact of COVID-19 on the economic performance of Informal Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in Thohoyandou, Limpopo province
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Assessment of the impact of COVID-19 on the economic performance of Informal Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in Thohoyandou, Limpopo province
detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic had profound economic consequences globally, with informal small and medium enterprises being among the most affected, particularly in developing economies. This study assessed the impact of COVID-19 on the economic performance of informal SMEs in Thohoyandou. The study was guided by the need to understand how pandemic-related disruptions influenced the sustainability and operational capacity of informal businesses. A qualitative explorative research design was employed to gain in-depth insights into the lived experiences of informal SME operators during the pandemic. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews and non-participant observations. Participants were selected using non-probability sampling technique and comprised informal SME owners operating in various sectors within Thohoyandou. The data were analysed using thematic analysis. The findings revealed that COVID-19 negatively affected informal SMEs through reduced sales, loss of customers, disruptions in supply chains, and limited access to financial support. However, some sectors such as restaurants, clothing and tailor shops demonstrated resilience through adaptive strategies such as diversification of products and informal networking. Socio-economic conditions, regulatory restrictions, and limited access to resources emerged as key factors influencing economic performance during the pandemic. The study concludes that while informal SMEs played a critical role in sustaining livelihoods, they were highly vulnerable to external shocks such as COVID-19. The study recommends targeted policy interventions and support mechanisms to enhance the resilience and sustainability of informal SMEs in future crises.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了COVID-19对南非索霍扬杜地区非正规中小企业的经济影响，发现疫情通过销售额下降、客户流失、供应链中断和融资受限等方式对其造成负面冲击，但部分行业（如餐饮、服装）通过产品多样化和非正式网络展现了韧性。
AI.research_question: COVID-19疫情如何影响非正规中小企业的经济绩效？哪些因素影响其在疫情中的表现？
AI.motivation: 非正规中小企业在发展中国家中扮演重要角色，但它们在外部冲击（如疫情）面前的脆弱性尚未得到充分关注，本研究旨在填补这一认知空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未明确提及特定理论，但隐含着企业韧性理论、危机管理理论以及非正规经济的制度理论视角。
AI.method: 定性探索性研究设计，采用半结构化访谈和非参与式观察收集数据，通过非概率抽样选取参与者，运用主题分析法分析数据。
AI.findings: COVID-19对非正规中小企业造成销售额下降、客户流失、供应链中断和融资受限等负面影响；但餐饮、服装等部分行业通过产品多样化和非正式网络展现了韧性；社会经济条件、监管限制和资源可及性是影响经济绩效的关键因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对非正规经济部门在外部冲击下脆弱性与韧性并存特征的理解，丰富了危机情境下非正规中小企业行为机制的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了有针对性的干预建议，包括设计专门的支持机制以增强非正规中小企业在未来危机中的韧性和可持续性。

title: 2026 Amendments to GAAR: Tiger Global and the Limits of Grandfathering
affiliations: Maastricht University, Faculty of Law

detail.title: 2026 Amendments to GAAR: Tiger Global and the Limits of Grandfathering
detail.abstract: This article reviews two recent administrative notifications (Notification No. 54/2026 and Notification 56/2026) from the Central Board for Direct Taxes, and explores the impact of applying India’s general anti-avoidance rule to income from the transfer of an investment and its application to an arrangement giving rise to a tax benefit. This distinction is particularly important in the aftermath of the Indian Supreme Court’s decision in Tiger Global.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾印度中央直接税委员会的两项行政通知（54/2026和56/2026），探讨印度一般反避税规则（GAAR）在投资转让收入及避税安排中的应用，特别是在印度最高法院Tiger Global案判决后的影响。
AI.research_question: 印度一般反避税规则（GAAR）如何适用于投资转让收入及产生税收利益的安排？Tiger Global案判决后对GAAR适用有何影响？
AI.motivation: 印度最高法院在Tiger Global案中的判决对GAAR的适用产生了重要影响，需要厘清行政通知中关于投资转让与避税安排的区别性规定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般反避税规则（GAAR）理论、税收利益安排认定理论、印度税法中的投资转让与避税安排区分理论。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，对行政通知（Notification No. 54/2026和56/2026）进行文本分析与解释，结合最高法院判例进行法律解释。
AI.findings: GAAR在投资转让收入与税收利益安排中的应用存在重要区别；Tiger Global案后，中央直接税委员会通过行政通知进一步明确了GAAR的适用范围和条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对GAAR在投资转让与避税安排之间区别的理论理解；为发展中国家反避税规则的应用提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税务从业者和纳税人理解印度GAAR的最新适用提供了指导；明确了行政通知对投资转让税收处理的实际影响。

title: How Much Has Shale Gas Saved U.S. Consumers?
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business

detail.title: How Much Has Shale Gas Saved U.S. Consumers?
detail.abstract:
It may seem like a distant memory now, but as of the mid-2000s, U.S. natural gas production had been flat for a decade, and the U.S. was importing liquefied natural gas (LNG), with plans to import much more. Then shale gas happened. Advances in hydraulic fracturing and horizontal drilling caused U.S. natural gas production to increase significantly, and the U.S. went from being a net importer of natural gas to being the world's largest exporter. This paper calculates how much shale gas has saved U.S. natural gas consumers. Using price differences between the United States, Europe and Japan, we calculate that U.S. natural gas consumers have saved $3.1-$4.3 trillion between 2007 and 2025, equivalent to $164-$227 billion annually. Access to low-price U.S. natural gas has been particularly valuable during major supply shocks such as the war in Ukraine, and the benefits of shale gas have been experienced broadly across sectors and states.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文计算了页岩气革命为美国天然气消费者带来的巨大经济收益。利用美国、欧洲和日本之间的价格差异，估算2007至2025年间美国消费者节省了3.1至4.3万亿美元（年均1640-2270亿美元），且这些收益广泛分布于各行业和各州，尤其在乌克兰战争等重大供应冲击时期价值凸显。
AI.research_question: 页岩气革命为美国天然气消费者节省了多少成本？这些节省的收益在不同时期（如乌克兰战争等供应冲击期间）和不同部门/地区如何分布？
AI.motivation: 页岩气革命使美国从天然气净进口国转变为全球最大出口国，这一巨大转变的经济影响值得量化。在面临全球能源危机（如乌克兰战争）时，本土廉价天然气的战略价值尤为突出。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利用套利/价格差异方法：通过比较美国天然气价格与欧洲、日本等市场的价格差异，估算美国消费者因页岩气带来的低价而获得的节省金额。
AI.method: 基于美国与欧洲、日本天然气市场的价格差异，计算2007-2025年间美国消费者因页岩气而支付更低价格的累积节省额。
AI.findings: 1）2007-2025年间美国消费者节省3.1-4.3万亿美元，年均164-227亿美元；2）页岩气带来的低价在乌克兰战争等全球供应冲击时期尤为宝贵；3）节省收益广泛分布于各行业和各州。
AI.theory_contributions: 量化了资源禀赋变化（页岩气技术突破）对消费者福利的直接经济影响，为能源经济学中关于能源独立和消费者剩余的研究提供了实证数据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了页岩气开发经济效益的量化证据；展示了能源技术突破对地缘政治韧性（如应对战争引发的供应危机）的战略价值；为国际能源市场定价机制分析提供了参考。

title: The Heterogeneous Bank Lending Channel of Monetary Policy
affiliations: , University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Department of Economics, , Banco de España and Banco de España

detail.title: The Heterogeneous Bank Lending Channel of Monetary Policy
detail.abstract:
How does heterogeneity in banks' interest-rate risk exposure shape monetary policy transmission? We develop a quantitative macroeconomic model of heterogeneous banks to answer this question. We establish an irrelevance result: differences in interest-rate risk exposure between fixed- and variable-rate banking systems matter for transmission only when bank solvency concerns become relevant. Calibrating the model to the euro area, we show that idiosyncratic default risk pushes a substantial share of banks toward the solvency threshold, making heterogeneity quantitatively important. When policy rates rise, fixed-rate banks suffer net interest margin compression---funding costs increase while legacy loan income stays unchanged---eroding capital and triggering sharper deleveraging. The lending elasticity to monetary policy is one-third larger in fixed-rate economies. The effects extend to financial stability: tightening raises bank failure rates in fixed-rate systems while lowering them in variable-rate systems. The results provide a rationale for macroprudential and monetary policy coordination and for monetary policy gradualism.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了异质性银行定量宏观模型，研究了银行间利率风险暴露的差异如何影响货币政策传导。核心发现是：固定利率与浮动利率银行体系间的利率风险差异仅在银行偿付能力成为问题时才重要。固定利率体系下，加息导致净息差压缩、资本侵蚀和更剧烈的去杠杆，贷款对货币政策的弹性高出三分之一，且加息提高固定利率体系的银行失败率。
AI.research_question: 银行利率风险暴露的异质性如何塑造货币政策传导机制？
AI.motivation: 现有宏观模型通常假设银行同质化，忽略了银行在利率风险暴露上的结构性差异（如固定利率与浮动利率贷款体系的差异）及其对货币政策传导和金融稳定的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性银行定量宏观模型，结合银行偿付能力约束和利率风险暴露差异（固定利率 vs 浮动利率）。
AI.method: 构建包含异质性银行的定量宏观经济模型，校准至欧元区数据，通过数值模拟分析不同利率风险暴露结构下的货币政策传导差异。
AI.findings: （1）利率风险差异仅在银行偿付能力成为关切时才影响传导；（2）固定利率银行在加息时面临净息差压缩（融资成本上升但存量贷款收益不变），侵蚀资本并导致更剧烈的去杠杆；（3）固定利率经济体中贷款对货币政策的弹性高出三分之一；（4）加息在固定利率体系中提高银行失败率，在浮动利率体系中降低失败率。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了银行利率风险暴露异质性在货币政策传导中的关键作用，建立了银行资产负债表结构（固定vs浮动利率）与货币政策效果之间的理论联系，证明了银行偿付能力约束是这一机制成立的前提条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观审慎与货币政策协调提供了理论依据，支持货币政策应渐进式调整的主张，提示政策制定者需关注银行体系利率风险结构对货币政策传导和金融稳定的差异化影响。

title: Measures For the Development of Special Economic Zones Authors

detail.title: Measures For the Development of Special Economic Zones Authors
detail.abstract: In the global economy, EPZs are viewed as an important second best policy instrument to promote industrialization, generate employment, and for regional development. The new SEZ policy gives a major thrust to SEZs. However the creation of SEZs alone does not ensure the realization of their potential. The government will need to play a more proactive role for effective realization of the full range of benefits from SEZs. The new SEZ policy has triggered a wide ranging debate in India. However, costs and benefits of SEZs have generated an intense debate, touching on almost every possible aspect of SEZs. Therefore, whether SEZs are beneficial for development remains a subject of controversy. In view of this ongoing debate, this paper is timely and will contribute to a better understanding of the dimensions of SEZs. It is therefore will help to understand the basic criticism and the measures to correct it and to develop SEZs that are people friendly.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了印度经济特区（SEZs）作为促进工业化、就业和区域发展的政策工具，分析了其成本与效益的争议，并指出政府需发挥更积极作用以实现SEZs的潜力，旨在帮助理解对SEZs的批评及改进措施。
AI.research_question: 经济特区（SEZs）对印度发展是否具有积极效益？如何应对其引发的争议与批评？
AI.motivation: 印度新经济特区政策引发了广泛而激烈的辩论，涉及SEZs的各个方面，其是否有利于发展仍存在争议。因此，需要一篇及时的研究来更好地理解SEZs的多维面向。
AI.theoretical_framework: "次优政策工具"理论（Second Best Policy Instrument），强调在无法实现最优政策条件下，EPZs/SEZs作为次优选择促进工业化与发展。
AI.method: 文献综述与政策分析（基于既有辩论和批评的综合分析）
AI.findings: 仅靠建立经济特区并不能确保其潜力实现；政府需要发挥更积极的作用才能有效实现SEZs的全部利益；SEZs引发了涉及几乎所有方面的成本-效益激烈辩论。
AI.theory_contributions: 深入剖析了SEZs作为次优政策工具的多维争议，为理解发展中国家特区政策的利弊提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者和相关方理解对SEZs的基本批评及纠正措施，指导开发更"亲民"的经济特区，为印度政府优化SEZ政策提供参考。

title: Governing AI in Resource-Constrained Environments: An Operational Framework for Nonprofit Organizations Adapting the Traffic Light Protocol and Escalation Threshold Theory to the Unprotected Sector

detail.title: Governing AI in Resource-Constrained Environments: An Operational Framework for Nonprofit Organizations Adapting the Traffic Light Protocol and Escalation Threshold Theory to the Unprotected Sector
detail.abstract: The existing literature on artificial intelligence adoption in nonprofit organizations focuses almost entirely on productivity use cases: drafting donor communications, automating newsletters, generating grant narratives. This paper addresses a different and more urgent question: what happens when AI goes wrong in a nonprofit, and what governance structures can a resource-constrained organization realistically put in place to prevent or interrupt that failure? Drawing on two prior frameworks, the Traffic Light Protocol for AI risk classification introduced in the context of judicial chambers, and the Sociotechnical Escalation Threshold model with its Threshold Proximity Score, this paper develops the first governance framework specifically designed for nonprofit organizations operating without dedicated IT security teams, legal counsel, or SRE infrastructure. We introduce the Zero-Infrastructure Governance Model, a four-component framework requiring no technology investment to implement. We adapt the Traffic Light Protocol to the nonprofit data environment, where the at-risk populations, refugees, low-income medical patients, undocumented immigrants, domestic violence survivors, are among the most vulnerable in any AI harm scenario. We adapt the Threshold Proximity Score to a five-indicator simplified version calibrated for nonprofit operational realities. And we introduce the concept of the Vulnerability Gap: the structural condition in which organizations handling the most sensitive Prasad MK | Governing AI in Resource-Constrained Environments | Page 2 populations operate with the least governance capacity. The paper concludes with implementation guidance organized by organizational budget tier and a policy agenda for nonprofit technology funders.

AI.tldr: 本文针对资源受限的非营利组织，提出了一个专门的AI治理框架——零基础设施治理模型。该模型无需任何技术投入，包含四个组件：适用于非营利数据环境的交通灯协议、简化版阈值接近度评分、漏洞差距概念，以及按预算分层的实施指南和资助者政策议程。论文填补了非营利组织AI失败场景下治理研究的空白。
AI.research_question: 当非营利组织中人工智能出现问题时，资源受限的组织能够实际实施什么样的治理结构来预防或中断这种失败？
AI.motivation: 现有文献几乎只关注非营利组织采用AI的生产力用例（如起草捐赠者沟通、自动化新闻通讯、生成资助叙述），而忽略了AI出错时对最弱势群体的伤害风险。非营利组织通常没有专门的IT安全团队、法律顾问或SRE基础设施，却处理着最敏感的人群数据，这种结构性矛盾亟需解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 交通灯协议——最初为司法机构引入的AI风险分类框架；2) 社会技术升级阈值模型及其阈值接近度评分；3) 作者提出的"漏洞差距"概念——处理最敏感人群的组织拥有最少治理能力的结构性条件。
AI.method: 基于两个现有框架（交通灯协议和阈值接近度评分）的适应性改造，结合非营利组织的运营现实，构建一个无需技术投入的四组件治理框架。
AI.findings: 提出"零基础设施治理模型"，包含：1) 适应非营利数据环境的交通灯协议（覆盖难民、低收入医疗患者、无证移民、家暴幸存者等最脆弱群体）；2) 简化版五指标阈值接近度评分；3) "漏洞差距"概念；4) 按预算分层的实施指南和资助者政策议程。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出针对非营利组织的AI治理框架；引入"漏洞差距"这一结构性概念，揭示资源匮乏与数据敏感性之间的反向关系；将司法领域的AI风险评估框架成功改造到非营利场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零预算非营利组织提供可落地的AI治理方案；按组织预算层级提供分步实施指南；为资助者提出政策议程建议，帮助资源最有限的组织保护最脆弱的群体。

title: Assessment Of Software Export Success Factors In Andhra Pradesh

detail.title: Assessment Of Software Export Success Factors In Andhra Pradesh
detail.abstract: Andhra Pradesh is the first state to create IT infrastructure and actively market it to MNCs. Present study is to analyze Andhra Pradesh software industry by using Software Export Success Model, and to suggest Andhra Pradesh software industry to improve its performance. SES model includes Independent variables, Moderating variables, Intervening variables and Dependent variable. The major finding is all variables in the SES model are progressive in Andhra Pradesh. Finally suggested measures for the development of software industry in Andhra Pradesh based on the factors in the SES model.

AI.tldr: 本文基于软件出口成功模型（SES Model），分析印度安得拉邦软件产业的发展现状，发现该模型中的所有变量均呈进步态势，并据此提出改进建议。
AI.research_question: 安得拉邦软件产业的发展现状如何？如何通过软件出口成功模型提升其产业绩效？
AI.motivation: 安得拉邦是印度首个建设IT基础设施并向跨国公司积极营销的邦，但其软件产业的系统分析仍然缺乏，因此本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 软件出口成功模型（Software Export Success Model, SES），包含自变量、调节变量、中介变量和因变量。
AI.method: 采用软件出口成功模型（SES）进行定量分析，考察各变量在安得拉邦软件产业中的表现。
AI.findings: SES模型中的所有变量（自变量、调节变量、中介变量、因变量）在安得拉邦均呈现进步趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 将软件出口成功模型（SES）应用于印度地方邦层面（安得拉邦）的实证分析，拓展了该模型的应用场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为安得拉邦软件产业提出基于SES模型各因素的具体发展建议，有助于地方政府和企业优化IT产业战略。

title: Bridging Health Equity and Climate Action With Digital Health: Nationwide Geospatial Modelling of Patient Dialysis Centre Travel in New Zealand
affiliations: The University of Sydney, The University of Sydney, The University of Sydney and

detail.title: Bridging Health Equity and Climate Action With Digital Health: Nationwide Geospatial Modelling of Patient Dialysis Centre Travel in New Zealand

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no competing interested.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The ASSET project, including this study, received ethics approval from the University of Sydney (HREC2020/871). The Health and Disability Ethics Committee, NZ, determined that the ASSET project was out of scope for ethics review due to the use of de-identified data.
declarations.funderStatement: JMB received funding during the course of this research from the Ross Bailey Nephrology Trust, Australian National Health and Medical Research Council (Postgraduate Scholarship ID 2031401), Australian Academy of Science’s Douglas and Lola Douglas Scholarship and a Women in Transplantation Research Fellowship Grant. KJLB received funding from Australian National Health and Medical Research Council (Investigator Grant 2023/GNT2025294).

detail.abstract:
​Background: Health service demands are increasing due to ageing populations, rising burdens of non-communicable diseases, and the accelerating climate crisis. The climate resilience of health systems to meet these increased demands is strengthened by providing care as close as possible to where people live. We present a low-cost digital method to measure patient travel burden and transport-related greenhouse gas emissions across alternative health service locations. 

Methods: In this nationwide, population-based study in New Zealand, routinely-collected health data for people with kidney failure were linked using the AcceSS and Equity in Treatment for kidney disease (ASSET) platform (n=6,705). Individual patient travel routes to the nearest dialysis centre were modelled to calculate minimum travel distance, time, and transport-related emissions (metric tons of carbon dioxide equivalent, tCO2e). Results were aggregated by health region. Dialysis population growth to 2028 was projected at regional and national levels. Location-allocation analysis using a p-median model compared 56 dialysis centre site options, balancing the needs of larger urban communities with improved equity for rural patients. 

Findings: By 2028, an estimated 2,395 people will be receiving in-centre haemodialysis in New Zealand (+49% increase from 2019). If dialysis units remain in current locations, this population will collectively travel 10·1 million km and 197,640 hours annually, generating 1,643 tCO2e in travel-related emissions. Interactive maps showed geographic variation in travel requirement. We selected ten optimal dialysis unit locations that could reduce total travel time by 21% (40,911 hours) and emissions by 27% (442 tCO2e).  

Interpretation: Routinely collected health data can be repurposed for patient travel analysis, greenhouse gas assessment and infrastructure planning. These methods could be applied more broadly to improve patient convenience, equity of access and environmental sustainability. Funding: Ross Bailey Nephrology Trust, National Health and Medical Research Council, Australian Academy of Science.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用新西兰肾衰竭患者的常规健康数据，通过低成本数字方法测量患者前往透析中心的旅行负担及相关温室气体排放，并优化透析中心选址以减少旅行时间和碳排放。
AI.research_question: 如何利用常规健康数据测量患者前往不同医疗服务地点的旅行负担和交通相关的温室气体排放，并据此优化卫生基础设施选址？
AI.motivation: 人口老龄化、非传染性疾病负担增加和气候危机加剧了卫生服务需求，增强卫生系统气候韧性的关键在于就近提供医疗服务。然而，目前缺乏低成本评估患者旅行负担和碳排放的方法来指导基础设施规划。
AI.theoretical_framework: 位置-分配分析（p-中值模型）、患者旅行负担测量、交通碳排放评估、卫生服务可及性与公平性理论。
AI.method: 基于新西兰全国肾衰竭患者数据（n=6,705），利用ASSET平台链接常规健康数据，模拟患者前往最近透析中心的旅行路线，计算最小旅行距离、时间和交通碳排放。采用p-中值模型进行位置-分配分析，比较56个透析中心选址方案，平衡城市社区需求与农村患者公平性。
AI.findings: 到2028年，新西兰预计有2,395人接受中心血液透析（较2019年增长49%）。若维持现有位置，患者年总旅行距离达1,010万公里、197,640小时，产生1,643 tCO2e排放。通过优化选址10个透析中心，可减少21%旅行时间（40,911小时）和27%碳排放（442 tCO2e）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种低成本、可推广的数字方法，将常规健康数据重新用于患者旅行分析、温室气体评估和卫生基础设施规划，弥合了卫生服务可及性与环境可持续性之间的研究缺口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为卫生决策者提供了实证工具，通过优化医疗服务选址减少患者旅行负担和碳排放，同时改善城乡之间的医疗可及性公平性。方法可推广至其他疾病领域和国家。

title: Distributing Accountability, Not Capability: Phase Separation and the LLM Workflow Quadrant in Autonomous AI Agent Architectures

detail.title: Distributing Accountability, Not Capability: Phase Separation and the LLM Workflow Quadrant in Autonomous AI Agent Architectures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Autonomous AI agents in business deployments exhibit a recurring failure mode: when an incident occurs, responsibility cannot be redirected to a separable contributor. The dominant discourse treats this as a single phenomenon, addressed by sandboxing, human-in-the-loop overload, or what Elish (2019) named the moral crumple zone. This paper argues the phenomenon is two architecturally distinct failure modes that have been conflated, and that the conflation is sustained by a missing positive name and a missing time-axis.

The paper introduces two contributions. First, a four-quadrant decomposition of business AI work — along the axes of deterministic vs semantic-judgment and pre-defined vs exploratory — yields a positive name for the cell most current LLM applications occupy: the LLM Workflow Quadrant. The quadrant is defined by a single load-bearing property: the path is decided in advance by humans or by code, and the LLM is called as a single bounded step within that path; the property divides naturally into a conversational sub-form (specialized chat agents) and a batch sub-form (single-purpose LLM functions inside deterministic pipelines). The decomposition distinguishes principled from artificial redirect impossibility: the former intrinsic to autonomous loops, the latter the product of routing workflow work through autonomous-loop architecture by elimination, with four downstream symptoms (the RPA exception-handling bottleneck, the sandbox-strength demand, the structural distortion of human-in-the-loop, and the dissolution of the accountability chain at postmortem). Second, a Phase Separation axis (design vs operation), independent of Quadrant, surfaces a Phase-crossing decision — recorded at deployment time, in one sentence — required when an autonomous-loop component is placed in the operation phase. The Phase axis descends recursively to skill-design granularity, where the Quadrant 3 ↔ Quadrant 4 boundary is a continuous gradient on which model capability is downstream of phase, not the primary lever.

The consequence is procedural rather than architectural: deployments make the Phase-crossing decision explicit, designate a pre-named gap-bearer for principled-impossibility placements, and route artificial-impossibility cases to re-architecture. The framework complements existing AI risk-management and management-system standards by recording the judgment layer they presuppose. Both rules are stated as experimental; the open questions are the research agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，当前关于AI Agent责任归属问题的讨论将两种架构上根本不同的失效模式混为一谈。作者提出一个四象限分解（确定性vs语义判断、预定义vs探索性）来命名LLM工作流象限，并引入一个独立的设计-运营阶段分离轴，揭示出部署时需要明确记录的"跨阶段决策"。核心结论是：应区分原则性不可归责（自治循环固有）与人为性不可归责（路由错误导致），并分别通过指定"缺口承担者"和重新架构来解决。
AI.research_question: 当AI Agent在商业部署中发生事故时，责任无法追溯到可分离的贡献者——这一现象究竟是一种还是两种不同的架构性失效模式？如果是两种，它们被混为一谈的原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 当前主流话语将AI事故责任归属问题视为单一现象（沙箱隔离、人在回路过载、道德褶皱区等），但这种笼统处理导致无法精准诊断和解决。作者观察到，有些责任不可归责是架构固有的（自治循环），有些则是人为制造出来的（将工作流任务错误地路由到自治循环架构中），二者需要区分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 四象限工作分解：确定性vs语义判断 × 预定义vs探索性，其中LLM工作流象限位于"预定义路径+语义判断步骤"；2) 阶段分离轴：设计阶段vs运营阶段，跨阶段决策需要在部署时以一句话形式记录；3) 原则性不可归责与人为性不可归责的区分；4) 递归到技能设计粒度的象限边界连续梯度。
AI.method: 概念分析/理论建构。通过架构性分解（四象限+阶段分离轴）对已有现象进行重新分类和命名，并推导出程序性规则。
AI.findings: 1) 存在两种混淆的失效模式：原则性不可归责（自治循环内在）与人为性不可归责（将工作流任务错误路由到自治循环架构）。2) 人为性不可归责有四种下游症状：RPA异常处理瓶颈、沙箱强度需求、人在回路的结构性扭曲、事后问责链消解。3) 阶段分离轴揭示了跨阶段决策的必要性：当自治循环组件被放置到运营阶段时，需要在部署时明确记录这一决策。4) 模型能力是阶段的因变量而非主要杠杆。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 命名并区分了两种架构性失效模式，打破当前"单一现象"话语；2) 提出LLM工作流象限作为缺失的正向命名；3) 引入阶段分离轴这一独立维度，补充了Elish(2019)的道德褶皱区理论；4) 提供了区分原则性与人为性不可归责的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 程序性规则：部署时明确记录跨阶段决策，为原则性不可归责场景指定"缺口承担者"，将人为性不可归责场景导向重新架构；2) 补充现有AI风险管理标准（如ISO管理标准）中缺失的判断层记录；3) 为工程团队提供诊断工具：通过四象限+阶段轴判断责任归属问题是架构问题还是路由问题。

title: The Impact of Telehealth Expansion on Doctor Shopping and Drug Overdose
affiliations: Boston University, Questrom School of Business, Department of Management Information Systems, Students, Boston University - Questrom School of Business and Boston University - Questrom School of Business

detail.title: The Impact of Telehealth Expansion on Doctor Shopping and Drug Overdose

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Telehealth technologies are transforming the U.S. healthcare system by enabling more efficient and costeffective access to quality care. However, this shift may also create new challenges, including increased opportunities for doctor shopping, where patients acquire controlled substances from multiple sources simultaneously. We examine the impact of telehealth expansion on doctor shopping by studying policy changes that increased telehealth adoption, including states' entry into the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC) and temporary federal licensure waivers during the COVID-19 pandemic. Using private insurance claims data from 2012 to 2022, we find that telehealth expansion increases doctor shopping and drug overdoses. The effect is concentrated among telehealth users without a prior history of doctor shopping, with null effects for non-telehealth users and for patients who engaged in doctor shopping prior to telehealth expansion. This indicates that the effects operate primarily at the extensive margin of doctor shopping and that telehealth adoption is a necessary condition for the effect to emerge. Furthermore, the effect size is approximately three times larger for rural patients (residing outside an MSA) than for urban patients, suggesting a cost-reduction mechanism. Finally, we examine the moderating role of Prescription Drug Monitoring Programs (PDMPs) in the telehealth era. Our findings document an unintended consequence of telehealth expansion and offer practical insights for policymakers and healthcare system designers.

AI.tldr: 远程医疗扩张增加了"逛医"行为（患者从多个渠道获取管制药物）和药物过量，该效应集中在无逛医史的新用户中，农村患者受影响程度是城市患者的三倍。处方药监测计划（PDMPs）可缓解此效应。
AI.research_question: 远程医疗扩张如何影响"逛医"行为（doctor shopping）及药物过量？
AI.motivation: 远程医疗在提升医疗可及性的同时，可能增加患者从多个处方源获取管制药物的机会（即"逛医"行为），造成阿片类药物滥用等公共卫生问题。已有研究尚未系统检验这一副作用及其异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于交易成本理论与监管合规理论，远程医疗降低了患者获取处方的时间与空间成本（尤其是农村地区），可能从广延边际（新用户）而非集约边际（老用户）催生逛医行为。
AI.method: 使用2012-2022年美国私人保险索赔数据，利用州际医疗执照契约（IMLC）进入及COVID-19期间联邦许可豁免作为远程医疗扩张的外生冲击，采用双重差分等因果识别方法。
AI.findings: （1）远程医疗扩张显著增加了逛医行为和药物过量；（2）效应集中在无逛医史的新用户（广延边际），对已有逛医史的患者无显著影响；（3）农村患者的效应量约为城市患者的3倍，表明成本降低是关键机制；（4）处方药监测计划（PDMPs）可调节该效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统识别远程医疗扩张在"逛医"行为上的非预期后果，区分了广延边际与集约边际的作用机制，并揭示了地理距离成本在其中的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和医疗系统设计者提供警示：远程医疗需要配套的监管机制（如PDMPs）以防止药物滥用；同时提示针对农村地区需加强监测与干预。

title: A Study On Financial Performance And Trends Of Selected E-Commerce Companies

detail.title: A Study On Financial Performance And Trends Of Selected E-Commerce Companies
detail.abstract: E-commerce is a platform that emerged as an outcome of 1991 Economic reforms where Information technology gave its birth for the promotion and integration of various countries. At present among all the businesses, e-commerce business is one of the fast growing in almost all the countries. There are different kinds of e-commerce business platforms emerged to sell and purchase different kinds of products which includes homogeneous goods with different brands and heterogeneous goods with same brands. The current study is analytical in nature and has been undertaken to analyse and predict the financial performance and Earnings per share (EPS) of top five e-commerce companies i.e.., Amazon, Walmart, Alibaba, e-bay and Make my trip. The Data analysis and Predictions were made by using Year on Year growth and Trend analysis on the basis of least square method. Results shows that the company's growth rate more or less are fluctuating and showing downward and negative trend, hence expected to decrease in near future if the appropriate measures are not taken.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了亚马逊、沃尔玛、阿里巴巴、eBay和Make My Trip五家头部电商企业的财务绩效与每股收益(EPS)，运用年增长率与最小二乘法趋势分析进行预测，发现这些企业增长波动较大且呈下行趋势，若不采取适当措施，未来可能进一步下滑。
AI.research_question: 如何分析和预测全球前五大电商公司的财务绩效与每股收益(EPS)？
AI.motivation: 电子商务是1991年经济改革后信息技术催生的快速发展的商业模式，但目前对头部电商企业财务表现的预测研究不足，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 年同比增长率、最小二乘法的趋势分析
AI.method: 采用分析性研究设计，运用年同比增长率(YoY Growth)和基于最小二乘法(Least Square Method)的趋势分析，对亚马逊、沃尔玛、阿里巴巴、eBay和Make My Trip五家公司进行数据分析和预测。
AI.findings: 五家电商公司的增长率均存在波动，呈现下行和负增长趋势。预测显示，若不采取适当措施，其财务表现与EPS将在短期内进一步下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 将最小二乘趋势分析法应用于电商企业财务绩效预测领域，验证了该方法在电商行业EPS预测中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电商企业管理层提供财务预警信号，提示需采取扭转负增长趋势的适当措施；为投资者提供电商板块投资决策参考。

title: What predicts actual e-government use? A proxy informants’ perspective
affiliations: Kozminski University, Wroclaw University, Faculty of Historical and Pedagogical Sciences, Institute of Psychology, Kozminski University and Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU) - School of Business

detail.title: What predicts actual e-government use? A proxy informants’ perspective
detail.abstract: During COVID-19, due to government mandated restrictions on face-to-face interactions, clients requiring services had no choice but to use e-government. This forced acceleration of digital solutions leads to the following question regarding the after COVID-19 era: To what extent do attitudes towards e-government services (or e-services) and trust in e-government and e-documents still predict the actual use of e-services? In an online survey, 956 government employees involved in the delivery of e-government services acted as proxy informants. The proxy informant approach was selected to overcome the bias, or systematic error in sampling of the population, as many previous studies used surrogate respondent samples, such as university students, internet cafe users, or even attendees at community concerts. Structural equation modeling was employed to validate a model encompassing three key predictors: attitude towards e-services, trust in e-government, and trust in e-documents. Based on more representative data, the findings reveal that trust in e-government is the strongest predictor of actual e-services use. Attitude towards e-services and trust in e-documents also show significant, though more moderate, effects. By shifting the focus from intention to actual usage and by examining the supply side of digital public services in a transition economy (Poland), this study contributes to e-government research in the post-COVID-19 context. The results suggest several recommendations for the planning and management of e-government, including enhancing transparency around e-documents and strengthening cybersecurity to improve clients’ trust. Future research should further investigate trust in e-documents and the exploration of additional factors that may influence e-government use.

AI.tldr: 本文基于波兰956名政府雇员的调查数据，采用代理知情者方法克服抽样偏差，运用结构方程模型发现：在后疫情时代，对电子政务的信任是预测电子政务服务实际使用的最强因素，而对电子服务的态度和对电子文件的信任也有显著但较温和的影响。
AI.research_question: 在后疫情时代，对电子政务服务（或电子服务）的态度、对电子政务的信任以及对电子文件的信任，在多大程度上仍能预测电子政务服务的实际使用？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情期间，政府强制限制面对面互动，迫使客户使用电子政务。这种被迫加速的数字化解决方案引出了后疫情时代的问题：这些态度和信任因素是否仍然能预测电子政务的实际使用？此外，以往研究多使用大学生、网吧用户等替代样本存在偏差，需要更代表性的数据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于态度-行为理论和技术接受模型，构建了一个包含三个关键预测因子（对电子服务的态度、对电子政务的信任、对电子文件的信任）的模型，以预测电子政务服务的实际使用。
AI.method: 采用在线问卷调查，以956名参与提供电子政务服务的政府雇员为代理知情者（proxy informants），克服以往研究的抽样偏差。运用结构方程模型（SEM）对假设模型进行验证。
AI.findings: （1）对电子政务的信任是预测电子政务服务实际使用的最强因素；（2）对电子服务的态度和对电子文件的信任也有显著但较温和的影响；（3）研究从意图转向实际使用，并在转型经济体（波兰）的公共服务供给侧进行了考察。
AI.theory_contributions: 将研究焦点从使用意图转向实际使用行为，弥补了以往研究多关注意图而非实际使用的不足；在疫情后背景下验证并更新了电子政务使用模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电子政务的规划与管理提出建议，包括增强电子文件的透明度、加强网络安全以提升客户信任。为转型经济体的电子政务发展提供了实证依据和政策参考。

title: Beyond the EHR: Event-Driven Patient Flow Coordination for High-Volume Specialty Care: A Conceptual Framework for Real-Time Clinical Flow Orchestration

detail.title: Beyond the EHR: Event-Driven Patient Flow Coordination for High-Volume Specialty Care: A Conceptual Framework for Real-Time Clinical Flow Orchestration

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a conceptual and theoretical analysis and does not involve human participants, patient data, or identifiable personal information. Therefore, institutional review board (IRB) or ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Orthopedic outpatient clinics represent one of the highest-throughput environments in ambulatory care, yet their patient movement systems remain fundamentally fragmented. Electronic health record (EHR) platforms manage clinical data effectively but provide no real-time coordination of physical patient progression across check-in, diagnostic imaging, rooming, and provider contact. The result is a well-documented pattern of provider idle time, imaging bottlenecks, front desk congestion, and patient dissatisfaction driven by opaque, poorly sequenced wait times (Rohleder et al., 2011; Saghafian et al., 2015). 

This paper proposes a conceptual framework for a Real-Time Clinical Flow Orchestration System (RTCFOS) — a middleware intelligence layer that sits between existing EHR infrastructure and operational clinic systems to dynamically route, queue, and coordinate patients based on visit type, imaging requirements, room availability, and provider readiness. The framework introduces a dual-pathway check-in model, smart kiosk routing logic, event-driven imaging dependency rules, and a privacy-safe anonymous queue display system compliant with HIPAA Security Rule standards. The paper further addresses integration strategy with major EHR platforms (Epic Systems, Oracle Health) via HL7 v2 and FHIR R4 standards, physical waiting room redesign principles optimized for orthopedic patient populations, human factors and change management considerations, a phased implementation roadmap, and a financial model projecting return on investment. 

The RTCFOS framework represents a clinically grounded, operationally feasible, and financially justifiable advancement in outpatient workflow intelligence — one that augments rather than replaces existing clinical systems and aligns with the current trajectory of FHIR-enabled healthcare interoperability. Prospective empirical validation through controlled pilot deployment is identified as the primary direction for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种实时临床流程编排系统（RTCFOS）的概念框架，作为一个中间智能层，在现有EHR基础设施和门诊操作系统之间动态路由、排队和协调患者，以解决骨科门诊患者流动系统碎片化的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个实时临床流程编排系统（RTCFOS）来协调骨科门诊患者的物理流动，减少瓶颈、提高效率并提升患者满意度？
AI.motivation: 骨科门诊是门诊护理中吞吐量最高的环境之一，但患者流动系统存在碎片化问题。EHR平台管理临床数据有效，但无法实时协调患者的物理进度，导致提供者空闲时间、影像瓶颈、前台拥堵以及患者因不透明的等待时间而产生不满。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实时临床流程编排系统（RTCFOS）框架，包含双路径签到模型、智能自助终端路由逻辑、事件驱动的影像依赖规则、符合HIPAA标准的隐私安全匿名队列显示系统，以及基于HL7 v2和FHIR R4标准的EHR集成策略。
AI.method: 概念框架设计，提出系统架构和实现策略，包括硬件布局、人力资源变革管理、分阶段实施路线图和财务投资回报模型。
AI.findings: RTCFOS框架是一个临床可行、操作可行且财务合理的门诊工作流智能增强方案，能够补充而非替代现有临床系统，并与FHIR驱动的医疗互操作性趋势一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个中间智能层的概念框架，弥合了EHR系统与物理患者流动之间的鸿沟；引入双路径签到模型和事件驱动的影像依赖规则等创新设计元素。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了与主流EHR平台（Epic、Oracle Health）的集成方案（HL7 v2/FHIR R4）；提出了针对骨科患者的等待室重新设计原则、变革管理策略、分阶段实施路线图和投资回报财务模型。

title: Measuring Destination Image in Real Time: Validating Large Language Model Scoring of Visual Diaries Against Established Scales
affiliations: and University of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

detail.title: Measuring Destination Image in Real Time: Validating Large Language Model Scoring of Visual Diaries Against Established Scales
detail.abstract: Destination image (DI) measurement has long faced a trade-off between quantitative rigor and qualitative richness. Structured surveys provide psychometric precision but impose researcherdefined attributes and are subject to retrospective bias, while open-ended methods preserve richer perceptions but require labor-intensive manual coding that limits scalability and rules out realtime monitoring. This study introduces and validates a method that combines visual diaries-brief spoken narratives recorded on participants' smartphones during the trip-with zero-shot large language model (LLM) scoring to bridge these two measurement traditions. In a longitudinal study of 187 tourists visiting the Canary Islands at three timepoints (pre-trip, during-trip, post-trip), diary transcripts were independently scored on cognitive, affective, and conative dimensions by an ensemble of three frontier LLMs (including GPT-4-class models) using theory-grounded prompts mapped to Beerli and Martín's (2004) destination image framework. Across the resulting scores we find adequate to strong psychometric properties: internal consistency (α = .84-.91), inter-model agreement (ICC = .72-.79), convergent validity with established survey scales (r = .69-.78), discriminant validity supported by confirmatory factor analysis and heterotrait-monotrait ratios, and criterion validity predicting satisfaction and behavioral loyalty at levels comparable to traditional survey measures. The LLM-derived scores also detect theoretically expected temporal patternsincluding cognitive updating during the trip and substantial heterogeneity in individual image trajectories-that retrospective single-shot surveys cannot resolve. The proposed pipeline reduces coding effort by orders of magnitude relative to manual content analysis, runs end-to-end within hours of data collection, and is fully reproducible from raw transcripts, the published prompts, and open analysis code. Sensitivity analyses across alternative prompt formulations, scoring models, and analytic specifications indicate that the validity evidence is robust rather than tied to a particular configuration. These findings suggest that visual diaries combined with LLM scoring offer a viable pathway for DI measurement that preserves narrative richness without sacrificing psychometric standards, enabling longitudinal, real-time, and large-scale designs—including in-trip monitoring and cross-destination comparison—that have been difficult to implement with existing methods.

title: Interpretability Myopia: Governance Fitness in Financial Risk Models
affiliations: IIMA

detail.title: Interpretability Myopia: Governance Fitness in Financial Risk Models
detail.abstract: Interpretable machine learning models are routinely favored for high-stakes deployment on the basis of predictive accuracy and architectural simplicity. This implicitly presumes that legibility alone suffices for trustworthy decision support. We argue this presumption is systematically myopic. Computational transparency does not guarantee that a model is expressive enough to encode the risk structures that governed decision environments demand. Legibility and governance fitness are orthogonal properties. Conflating them has yielded models that are transparent about what they capture yet structurally incapable of representing what they miss. We formalize this critique through a three-tier evaluation framework applied to six classifier families across four financial benchmark datasets. The first tier assesses discrimination, operational utility under stochastic portfolio simulation, and three distinct dimensions of stability. These are structural stability of learned representations, functional stability of predictive outputs, and individual group membership stability across resampled conditions. Existing work overwhelmingly restricts attention to functional stability, ignoring whether model architecture and group-level assignments persist under perturbation. The second tier profiles deployment suitability across robustness, parsimony, reproducibility, calibration, scenario resilience, and decision-policy adaptability. The third constructs a governance stress test probing six structural failure classes: subgroup heterogeneity, risk amplification, proxy discrimination, trajectory asymmetry, conditional non-monotonicity, and protective factor failure. Bootstrap-validated experiments confirm that marginal-additive and recursive-partitioning architectures exhibit these deficiencies as inherent consequences of their design. No single model dominates all three tiers. Ensembles lead on utility, linear models on stability, and pattern-based methods uniquely expose governance failures as auditable, first-class outputs. Governance fitness remains a critical yet underdeveloped axis of model selection in regulated domains. Ensembles engineered for structural coverage consistently outperform individual classifiers in meeting this requirement.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了"可解释性等于可信赖"的普遍假设，提出可解释性与治理适应性是正交属性。通过三层评估框架对六类分类器进行实证分析，发现边缘加法和递归分区架构存在固有的治理缺陷，且没有单一模型能在所有维度上胜出。集成模型在结构覆盖和治理适应性方面表现最优。
AI.research_question: 可解释的机器学习模型是否天然具备治理适应性？模型的可解释性（透明性）与治理适应性（能否编码风险结构、支持决策）是否是同一回事？
AI.motivation: 当前高风险决策领域普遍认为"可解释模型因简单透明而值得信赖"，但这一假设忽视了模型表达能力不足可能导致的治理失败。有必要系统性地检验可解释性与治理适应性之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三层评估框架：第一层（判别能力、操作效用、三类稳定性——结构稳定性、功能稳定性、群体成员稳定性）；第二层（部署适应性：鲁棒性、简约性、可复现性、校准度、情景韧性、决策策略适应性）；第三层（治理压力测试：子群体异质性、风险放大、代理歧视、轨迹不对称、条件非单调性、保护因素失效）。
AI.method: 在四个金融基准数据集上对六类分类器家族进行实证评估，采用Bootstrap验证方法，系统测试三层框架中各维度的表现。
AI.findings: （1）边缘加法和递归分区架构的治理缺陷是其设计固有的；（2）没有单一模型能在三层评估中全面胜出；（3）集成模型在操作效用上领先，线性模型在稳定性上领先，模式基方法能独特地将治理失败暴露为可审计的一级输出；（4）针对结构覆盖设计的集成模型在治理适应性上始终优于单个分类器。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分并正式论证了"可解释性"与"治理适应性"是正交属性，打破了学界和业界长期默认的"透明即可信"假设；提出三维稳定性概念（结构、功能、群体成员），超越现有研究仅关注功能稳定性的局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高风险决策（如金融、监管）领域的模型选择提供了可操作的治理压力测试框架；明确指出了边缘加法和递归分区架构在治理上的固有缺陷，建议从业者优先考虑集成模型以提升治理适应性。

title: Returns to Green Tasks in Europe: Evidence from Online Job Vacancies
affiliations: UK Health Security Agency, Fondazione Eni Enrico Mattei (FEEM), Milan, Grantham Research Institute, London School of Economics and Political Science, London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) and University of Milan

detail.title: Returns to Green Tasks in Europe: Evidence from Online Job Vacancies
detail.abstract: There is growing evidence that green jobs have higher skill requirements, but whether they offer sufficient wage incentives to encourage workers to acquire those skills remains unclear. We study the green wage premium and its drivers to isolate the average return to green tasks using online job vacancy (OJV) data for EU countries over the period 2018-2023. We develop a transparent LLM-based approach to classify job vacancies as green when they list at least one green task. Green jobs pay a premium of 5.5% relative to comparable postings within the same occupation, and this estimate is little changed when controlling for nonmonetary job attributes making these jobs more attractive. Roughly half of this premium is explained by firm fixed effects, consistent with an important role for firm rents. An Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition shows that the higher skill complexity explains a further one tenth of the premium, leaving a residual return to green tasks of around 2%. The green wage premium is higher outside the manufacturing sector, and for low-carbon roles.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2018-2023年欧盟在线招聘数据，通过LLM分类方法识别绿色岗位，发现绿色岗位相比同类非绿色岗位有5.5%的工资溢价，其中约一半由企业固定效应解释，技能复杂度解释约十分之一，绿色任务本身的回报率约2%。
AI.research_question: 绿色岗位是否存在工资溢价？如果有，其驱动因素是什么？如何隔离绿色任务本身的平均回报率？
AI.motivation: 已有证据表明绿色岗位技能要求更高，但这些岗位是否提供足够的工资激励以鼓励劳动者获取相关技能尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工资溢价理论、Oaxaca-Blinder分解、企业租金分享理论、技能复杂度与工资关系。
AI.method: 利用2018-2023年欧盟在线招聘数据，开发基于LLM的透明分类方法识别绿色岗位（包含至少一项绿色任务），通过回归分析估计绿色工资溢价，并采用Oaxaca-Blinder分解探索溢价来源。
AI.findings: 绿色岗位比同职业可比岗位高5.5%的工资溢价；控制非货币属性后溢价基本不变；约一半溢价由企业固定效应（企业租金）解释；技能复杂度解释约十分之一；绿色任务本身回报率约2%；制造业外和低碳岗位的绿色溢价更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统隔离了绿色任务本身的工资回报率，揭示了企业租金在绿色工资溢价中的主导作用，为理解绿色转型中的劳动市场激励机制提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估绿色就业激励措施提供实证依据；为企业薪酬设计和劳动者职业选择提供参考；有助于理解绿色转型对劳动力市场的分配效应。

title: Feature-Specific Price Sensitivity Among Young Urban Indian Smartphone Buyers: Principal-Agent Dynamics and Feature Valuation Hierarchies
affiliations: , Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies (University of Delhi), Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies (University of Delhi), Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies (University of Delhi), Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies (University of Delhi), Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies (University of Delhi), Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies (University of Delhi) and Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies (University of Delhi)

detail.title: Feature-Specific Price Sensitivity Among Young Urban Indian Smartphone Buyers: Principal-Agent Dynamics and Feature Valuation Hierarchies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests or conflicts of interest related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Participation was voluntary and anonymous. Informed consent was obtained from all participants prior to survey completion. No personally identifiable information was collected.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Young urban Indians aged 18–34 constitute the core buyer for India’s mid-range smartphone segment, yet the feature-level pricing dynamics that govern their purchase decisions remain empirically underexamined. This study examines feature-specific price sensitivity and its demographic moderators among this population in the Rs.15,000 segment, applying a principal-agent framework to predict how payment structure shapes price responsiveness. A purposive sample of 127 young urban Indian consumers evaluated five feature upgrades — storage, camera, random access memory, charging speed, and battery life — at two price points. Storage attracted the strongest baseline preference and the lowest price sensitivity; battery life attracted the weakest preference and the highest sensitivity. The feature hierarchy was statistically significant and demographically invariant across all tested buyer groups. Consistent with principal-agent predictions, parent-funded buyers exhibited twice the composite price sensitivity of self-funders, and buyers aged 18–24 were more sensitive than the 25–34 cohort. These two effects share substantial variance, suggesting they co-express a latent construct of parental financial dependence rather than independent mechanisms. Gender, income, and usage intensity returned null results. Across demographic groups, what varies is not which features are valued but how acutely price resistance manifests when upgrades must be justified to a third-party funder.

AI.tldr: 本研究以127名印度年轻城市消费者为样本，探讨中端智能手机（约15000卢比）的功能升级价格敏感度。发现存储最受青睐且价格弹性最低，电池寿命偏好最弱但价格敏感度最高。代际出资模式是关键调节变量：父母出资者的价格敏感度是自费者的两倍，且18-24岁群体比25-34岁更敏感，两者的高重叠方差表明其共同表达"父母经济依赖"这一潜在构念。性别、收入和使用强度无显著调节效应。
AI.research_question: 印度18-34岁城市年轻消费者在中端智能手机（15000卢比价位）的功能升级中，价格敏感度如何在不同功能特征间分布？人口统计学因素（尤其是出资方式、年龄、性别、收入、使用强度）如何调节这一敏感度？
AI.motivation: 该群体构成印度中端智能手机的核心购买力，但特征层面的定价动态及其购买决策机制在实证研究中仍缺乏系统考察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托-代理框架（principal-agent framework）：预测支付结构（父母出资 vs. 自费）如何塑造价格响应模式。隐含假设是父母作为"委托人"、子女作为"代理人"，代理人在使用委托人资金时会产生更强的价格约束感知。
AI.method: 有目的抽样（purposive sample），127名印度年轻城市消费者；对五项功能升级（存储、摄像头、RAM、充电速度、电池续航）在两个价格点进行评价；统计分析包括特征偏好排序、价格敏感度比较及人口统计学调节效应检验。
AI.findings: （1）存储偏好最强且价格敏感度最低，电池续航偏好最弱且敏感度最高；（2）特征偏好层级在统计上显著且在不同人口群体间具有不变性；（3）父母出资者的综合价格敏感度是自费者的两倍；（4）18-24岁比25-34岁更敏感；（5）年龄效应与出资效应高度重叠，指向"父母经济依赖"这一潜在构念；（6）性别、收入、使用强度无显著效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将委托-代理理论从传统组织情境拓展至家庭消费决策场景，揭示了"第三方出资"（父母）对个体价格敏感度的系统性放大机制，并识别出资方式和年龄并非独立调节变量，而是共同表达同一潜在构念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为手机厂商在中端市场的功能定价策略提供实证依据：存储应作为核心锚定功能，电池溢价能力有限；营销沟通需针对"父母出资型"消费者调整话术，强化功能"可辩护性"以降低第三方出资阻力。

title: Commitment Under Uncertainty: A Costly Signaling Approach
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Commitment Under Uncertainty: A Costly Signaling Approach
detail.abstract: Early relationships involve extreme information asymmetry. Most available signals-words, gestures, emotional expressions-are cheap to produce. Costly signaling theory suggests that actions carrying real personal cost might reveal more. This paper outlines a behavioral observation approach built around temporal compression: creating a short window where stated commitments must turn into observable behavior. Under that pressure, several patterns tend to surface. Polished self-presentation frays. Boundary conversations get reframed away from the original issue. Strong early compliance sometimes gives way to gradual disengagement. And the observer's own sunk costs can start driving the decision. A tiny pilot log (N=35, eight weeks) found that people whose relationships dissolved tended to have lower follow-through and declining consistency trends. That's just a description of a convenience sample-nothing more. The approach is provisional and keeps changing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于时间压缩的行为观察方法，用于在早期关系中通过让承诺转化为可观察行为来揭示真实信号，并通过小规模试点发现关系破裂者的跟进行为和一致性呈下降趋势。
AI.research_question: 在早期关系中，如何通过行为观察方法有效识别哪些信号是可信的、能预示关系能否持续？
AI.motivation: 早期关系存在极端的信息不对称，且大多数可获得的信号（言语、表情等）生产成本低廉，可能具有欺骗性。依据成本信号理论，真正承担个人成本的行动才能揭示真实意图，因此需要一种方法来捕捉这种信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本信号理论——该理论认为，只有携带真实个人成本的行动才能可靠地传递信号，因为欺骗者不愿承担同样的代价。
AI.method: 提出"时间压缩"行为观察方法，即创造短期窗口迫使承诺转化为可观察行为。通过小规模试点（N=35，八周跟踪）进行验证。
AI.findings: 在时间压缩压力下，几种典型模式浮现：精心的自我呈现开始瓦解；边界对话被重新框定偏离原议题；早期高度顺从可能逐渐转为退出；观察者自身的沉没成本开始影响决策。试点中，关系破裂者的跟进行为和一致性呈下降趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 将成本信号理论从演化生物学领域引入早期关系研究，并为该理论在人际互动中的操作性测量提供了"时间压缩"这一可执行的方法框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者、管理者或关系中的个体提供了一种低成本、可操作的行为观察工具，可在早期阶段识别不可持续的关系，减少因信息不对称导致的错误投入。

title: GC-NODE: A Gated Controlled Neural ODE-Based Structured Decoupling Model for User Addictive Behavior Dynamics
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin Institute of Technology and Harbin Institute of Technology - School of Management

detail.title: GC-NODE: A Gated Controlled Neural ODE-Based Structured Decoupling Model for User Addictive Behavior Dynamics

publicationDetails.detailsText: This paper has been accepted by The 19th China Summer Workshop on Information Management (CSWIM 2026)

detail.abstract: Modeling user psychological states in digital health faces challenges regarding irregular time intervals and dynamic resistance to interventions. Existing discrete models distort dynamics, while black-box differential equations fail to isolate causal effects. We propose GC-NODE (Gated Controlled Neural ODE), a continuous-time framework modeling psychological evolution as a controlled differential equation. It employs a structural decoupling mechanism to explicitly separate system dynamics into endogenous drift, exogenous control, and statedependent resistance gating. This physically constrained architecture improves prediction accuracy on irregular time series and enables the inference of dynamic resistance curves and counterfactual trajectory deduction. Experiments on large-scale panel data demonstrate that GC-NODE outperforms baselines in prediction and interpretability, providing a theoretical basis for personalized intelligent interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GC-NODE（门控受控神经ODE），一个连续时间框架，通过结构解耦机制将心理演化建模为内生漂移、外源控制和状态依赖的阻力门控，在数字健康不规则时间序列数据上实现更优的预测和可解释性，为个性化智能干预提供理论支持。
AI.research_question: 如何在数字健康领域中，针对不规则时间间隔和动态干预阻力，对用户心理状态进行连续时间建模，并实现因果效应的隔离与可解释性？
AI.motivation: 现有离散模型扭曲了心理状态的动态变化，黑箱微分方程无法隔离因果效应，缺乏既能处理不规则时间序列又能提供可解释性的连续时间建模框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 受控微分方程、结构解耦机制（内生漂移+外源控制+状态依赖阻力门控）、神经ODE（神经常微分方程）
AI.method: 提出GC-NODE（Gated Controlled Neural ODE）连续时间框架，采用结构解耦机制将系统动力学显式分离为三个可解释的组成部分，在大规模面板数据上进行实验验证。
AI.findings: GC-NODE在预测性能上优于基线模型，能够推断动态阻力曲线和反事实轨迹，在不规则时间序列预测和可解释性方面均表现出色。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个具有物理约束的连续时间建模框架，将心理动力学显式解耦为内生、外源和阻力门控三个机制，提供了理论上的新视角和分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字健康中的个性化智能干预提供了理论基础，能够推断用户的动态阻力曲线和反事实轨迹，从而支持更精准的干预策略设计。
