detail.abstract:
Fairness is the most universally understood concept in human civilisation and the least institutionally protected. There is no court of fairness, no law of it, no regulator, no mechanism of correction. The artificial intelligence revolution did not create this problem. It made it mathematically precise, financially quantifiable, and — for the first time in human history — governable.

This paper develops the Fairness Dividend™ — a civilisational governance framework demonstrating, with the rigour of capital asset pricing theory, that the governance architecture which distributes the AI productivity dividend equitably is mathematically identical to the architecture that generates the highest risk-adjusted return for every stakeholder in the system. The central proof: on an £85,000 AI deployment with a Board Compliance Score™ of 23/100, the annual cost of governance failure is £287,400. The annual cost of closing the governance gap is £70,000. The net Governance Dividend™ is £217,400 per year. Not a social metric. A financial one.

The paper introduces twelve original proprietary frameworks including the Algorithmic Arbitrage Frontier™, the Sovereign Automation Spread™, the Cognitive Profile Calibration Metric™, the Picken Hierarchy™ (a five-level replacement for Maslow's hierarchy of needs for the post-AI world), the AI Levy™, the Universal Governance Dividend™, and the Qualified Output Signatory™ — a technology-agnostic accountability mechanism that addresses the structural governance gap that existing regulatory frameworks, including the EU AI Act, assume is filled but do not require.

Twenty-five scenarios across five continents document the displacement cascade currently underway. The paper concludes with a sequenced three-phase transition architecture — 2026 to 2033 and beyond — and a formal account of the Governance Singularity™: the threshold beyond which the governance architecture built now determines everything about what follows.

Keywords: AI governance, capital asset pricing theory, board accountability, consequence displacement, Qualified Output Signatory, fairness dividend, displacement economy, neurodivergent employment, universal basic income, governance singularity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"公平红利™"框架，论证AI生产力红利的公平分配架构与最大化风险调整后收益的治理架构在数学上等价。以一个£85,000的AI部署为例，治理失败年成本£287,400，弥合治理缺口年成本£70,000，净治理红利£217,400/年。文章引入12个原创框架，提出"治理奇点™"概念，并设计了2026-2033年的三阶段转型架构。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种治理架构，使得AI生产力红利的公平分配与所有利益相关者的最高风险调整后收益在数学上等价？
AI.motivation: 公平是人类文明中最普遍理解却最缺乏制度保障的概念。AI革命使公平问题变得数学精确、财务可量化且首次可治理，因此需要一套新的治理框架来应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本资产定价理论（CAPT）、Board Compliance Score™、Algorithmic Arbitrage Frontier™、Picken Hierarchy™（后AI时代五层次需求层次理论替代方案）、Governance Singularity™等12个原创框架。
AI.method: 理论推导与数学证明，结合25个跨五大洲的情景分析（document displacement cascade），以及量化计算案例（£85,000 AI部署的治理成本效益分析）。
AI.findings: 1) 公平分配AI红利的治理架构与最大化风险调整收益的架构数学等价；2) 弥合治理缺口产生净正向财务收益（£217,400/年）；3) 现有监管框架（包括EU AI Act）存在结构性治理缺口；4) 提出Qualified Output Signatory™作为技术无关的问责机制来填补该缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 将资本资产定价理论引入AI治理领域，证明公平与效率在治理架构中的数学等价性；提出"治理奇点"概念——当前治理架构决定了此后的一切；用Picken Hierarchy替代马斯洛需求层次理论以适配后AI世界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可量化的治理成本效益分析工具（如Board Compliance Score™与Fairness Dividend™的财务化计算）；提出Qualified Output Signatory™作为填补监管缺口的实操问责机制；设计2026-2033年的三阶段转型路线图。

title: The Uncounted: A Case for Federal Enumeration of the Bereaved Parent Demographic in the United States

detail.title: The Uncounted: A Case for Federal Enumeration of the Bereaved Parent Demographic in the United States

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no personal or financial relationships with any organization that could be perceived to have influenced this study. This research was conducted independently with no external funding.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents a policy argument using publicly available published data and peer-reviewed literature. No human subjects research was conducted. No ethics approval is required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. Conducted independently by the author under The Echoes Project.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This paper is a public health policy argument using publicly available published data. No clinical trial was conducted.

detail.abstract: The National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS), as the designated federal statistical agency for health data under Section 306 of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 242k), collects, analyzes, and disseminates mortality data on the population of the United States. The existing data infrastructure documents the deceased: cause of death, age, sex, race, ethnicity, and geography. It does not enumerate the surviving parent population-the bereaved parents who outlive their children and who carry documented, measurable, long-term public health consequences as a result of that loss. This paper presents a forensic case for the federal enumeration of the bereaved parent demographic as a standard annual public health data collection. The United States bereaved parent population is estimated at 18.7 million individuals (Evermore, 2022), with independent corroboration from the Center for Advanced Pain Studies at the University of Texas at Austin (2026). This population carries documented elevated mortality risk, psychiatric hospitalization risk, marital disruption, workforce productivity loss, and long-term health system burden-all measurable, all consequential, and none currently tracked in any federal data system. The absence of a federal count is not a data limitation. It is a data gap-the result of a framing failure in which bereaved parents have been classified as a grief population requiring service delivery rather than a public health demographic requiring enumeration. This paper presents the evidentiary case for reclassification and formal federal counting.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了美国联邦卫生统计系统应将"丧子父母"作为标准公共健康人口统计类别进行年度数据采集，而非仅将其视为需要服务提供的悲伤群体。目前估计美国有1870万丧子父母，他们面临更高的死亡率、精神疾病住院风险、婚姻破裂、劳动力损失和长期医疗负担，但这些数据未被任何联邦系统追踪。
AI.research_question: 美国联邦卫生统计系统是否应将丧子父母群体作为标准公共健康人口统计类别进行正式、年度化的数据采集？
AI.motivation: 现有美国死亡数据基础设施仅记录逝者信息（死亡原因、年龄、性别、种族、族裔、地理分布），但未统计在世的丧子父母群体。该群体约1870万人，承载着可测量的长期公共健康后果（升高的死亡率、精神病住院风险、婚姻破裂、劳动生产率损失等），却由于"框架失败"——被归类为需要服务提供的悲伤群体而非需要统计的公共健康人口——而未被任何联邦数据系统追踪。这一数据缺失不是数据局限，而是系统性数据空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共健康人口统计学框架（将丧子父母从"悲伤服务群体"重新分类为"公共健康人口统计类别"）；数据基础设施理论（区分"数据局限"与"数据空白"的 framing failure 分析）
AI.method: 法证式（forensic）论证方法：通过已有独立估算数据（Evermore, 2022; 德州大学奥斯汀分校高级疼痛研究中心, 2026）作为佐证，结合对现有联邦数据系统框架缺陷的分析，构建重新分类和联邦统计的证据链。
AI.findings: 1. 美国丧子父母人口约1870万，有独立数据源相互印证；2. 该群体存在可测量的、已被文献证实的多重公共健康后果（死亡率、精神健康、婚姻、劳动力、医疗系统负担）；3. 现有联邦数据系统存在系统性"数据空白"而非"数据局限"，根源在于分类框架错误——将丧子父母视为服务对象而非统计对象。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"框架失败"（framing failure）概念，区分"数据局限"与"数据空白"，为公共健康数据基础设施的设计提供了新的分类理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国联邦机构（如NCHS）提供了将丧子父母纳入年度标准公共健康数据采集的政策论证和操作依据，有助于改善该群体的健康监测、资源分配和公共健康干预。

title: Provincial Disparities in Child Stunting in Cambodia: A Bayesian Hierarchical Spatial Analysis, 2005–2021–22
affiliations: Ajou University School of Medicine and Ajou University School of Medicine

detail.title: Provincial Disparities in Child Stunting in Cambodia: A Bayesian Hierarchical Spatial Analysis, 2005–2021–22

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The datasets were accessed through the DHS Program website (https://dhsprogram.com) following the approval of a standard registration request. Additional institutional review board approval for this secondary analysis was not sought because the datasets were anonymised and contained no identifiable participant information.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract:
Background: Despite significant national progress in child health, stunting remains a major public health challenge in Cambodia, as national averages often mask substantial subnational variations. This study aimed to examine provincial disparities in child stunting trends in Cambodia from 2005 to 2021–22.

Methods: We analysed data from children younger than 5 years from four Cambodia Demographic and Health Surveys conducted in 2005, 2010, 2014, and 2021–22. We employed a Bayesian hierarchical spatial model with a Besag–York–Mollié 2 structure to analyse province-year aggregated data, adjusting for child, maternal, household, and water, sanitation, and hygiene-related covariates. We estimated model-based fitted prevalence, prevalence differences relative to Phnom Penh, and average annual percentage changes.

Findings: National stunting prevalence declined from 43·91% in 2005 to 23·34% in 2021–22. However, marked provincial disparities persisted throughout the study period. Compared with Phnom Penh, a high burden remained in provinces including Ratanak Kiri, Stung Treng, and Preah Vihear. The fastest improvements were observed in Banteay Meanchey and Battambang. These findings indicate that both the remaining burden and the pace of improvement were geographically uneven.

Interpretation: Although Cambodia achieved a marked reduction in child stunting, provincial inequalities remained. Province-specific monitoring and geographically targeted nutrition and development strategies are needed to address persistent inequalities in child nutrition.

AI.tldr: 基于2005-2022年柬埔寨人口健康调查数据，采用贝叶斯层次空间模型分析发现，尽管柬埔寨儿童发育迟缓率从43.91%大幅下降至23.34%，但各省份间存在显著且持续的不平等，偏远省份（如Ratanak Kiri）负担最重，而部分地区改善速度更快。
AI.research_question: 2005年至2021-22年间柬埔寨各省份儿童发育迟缓趋势的不平等状况如何？
AI.motivation: 全国平均水平掩盖了显著的地方差异，需要揭示亚国家级别的发育迟缓不平等，以便为针对性干预提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯层次空间模型（Besag-York-Mollié 2结构），用于分析省份-年份聚合数据。
AI.method: 分析四次柬埔寨人口健康调查（2005、2010、2014、2021-22）中5岁以下儿童数据，采用贝叶斯层次空间模型（BYM2结构），调整儿童、母亲、家庭及水卫设施等协变量，估计模型拟合患病率、与金边的患病率差异及年均百分比变化。
AI.findings: 全国发育迟缓率从43.91%降至23.34%，但各省间不平等持续存在。Ratanak Kiri、Stung Treng、Preah Vihear等省份负担最重，Banteay Meanchey和Battambang改善最快。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了贝叶斯层次空间模型在分析发展中国家亚国家级健康不平等中的适用性，揭示了全国平均趋势掩盖下的地理异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为柬埔寨及类似发展中国家提供了省际儿童营养不平等证据，强调了省份特异性监测和地理靶向营养干预策略的必要性。

title: Children missed by routine vaccination in India: interpretable neural networks and logistic regression for zero-dose and dropout
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Delhi, University of Montreal and Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Delhi

detail.title: Children missed by routine vaccination in India: interpretable neural networks and logistic regression for zero-dose and dropout

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the Canadian Institutes of Health Research (CIHR) [Grant/Award number: 40434].

detail.abstract: BackgroundReaching zero-dose children, defined here as children who have not received a first DTP-containing dose, is a global priority. However, zero-dose counts do not capture children who start vaccination and later drop out. In India, many children remain under-immunised, meaning that they miss one or more routine vaccine doses. We assessed whether the risk profile differs between non-initiation and later dropout, across geography, and beyond what additive regression can represent.Methods We analysed NFHS-5 child records for three outcomes: zero-dose (43{,}181 children; 2{,}976 positive), within-series dropout (DTP1--DTP3), defined as failure to complete the three-dose DTP-containing series after initiation (40{,}186; 2{,}578 positive), and cross-series dropout (BCG--MCV1), defined as receipt of BCG but not a first measles-containing vaccine dose across the first-year schedule (40{,}985; 3{,}510 positive). We fitted penalised logistic regression and feed-forward neural networks at pooled India, five macro-regions, and state level. To compare additive and non-additive risk structure, we used Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) and interaction analyses.FindingsAt pooled India level, the neural network improved accuracy and Macro-F1 for all three outcomes; the largest gain was for cross-series dropout (BCG--MCV1). On a common SHAP scale, zero-dose risk was driven more strongly by deprivation, home delivery, and rural residence, whereas the two dropout outcomes gave greater weight to child age, birth order, and maternal educational disadvantage. Interaction analyses showed moderate non-additive structure centred on deprivation, maternal education, birth order, and service-contact variables. Regionally, Macro-F1 improved in all 15 region-outcome cells. At state level, mean gains remained positive, but minority-class detection was inconsistent; the main contribution at that scale was localisation of heterogeneous drivers and interaction pairs.InterpretationChildhood under-immunisation in India is not a single process. The risk profile differs between children who never start routine vaccination and those who start but do not complete it, and it varies across regions and states. Flexible models added value mainly by clarifying that structure rather than by simple algorithmic superiority.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了印度儿童免疫接种不足的两种类型——从未接种（零剂量）与接种后中途脱落（系列内脱落和跨系列脱落），发现两者的风险特征存在显著差异，且这种差异在不同地理区域间表现不同。神经网络模型比传统加性回归更能揭示这种非加性的风险结构。
AI.research_question: 印度儿童免疫接种不足中，从未接种（零剂量）与接种后中途脱落的儿童，其风险特征是否存在差异？这种差异是否随地理区域变化？非加性风险结构是否比传统加性回归更能解释这一现象？
AI.motivation: 全球优先关注零剂量儿童，但零剂量数据无法捕捉那些开始接种后又脱落的儿童。在印度，许多儿童属于"免疫不足"状态（漏掉一种或多种常规疫苗剂量）。需要区分不启动接种与后期脱落的儿童在风险特征上的差异，以制定更有针对性的干预策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非加性风险结构理论；Shapley加性解释（SHAP）框架；神经网络与加性回归的对比分析框架。
AI.method: 使用印度NFHS-5儿童记录数据，分析三个结局变量：零剂量（43,181名儿童）、系列内脱落（DTP1→DTP3，40,186名）、跨系列脱落（BCG→MCV1，40,985名）。采用惩罚逻辑回归和前馈神经网络在全印度、五个宏观区域和邦级层面进行建模，通过SHAP和交互分析比较加性与非加性风险结构。
AI.findings: （1）全印度层面，神经网络在三个结局上均提高了准确率和Macro-F1，其中跨系列脱落改善最显著；（2）零剂量风险更多由贫困、在家分娩和农村居住驱动，而两种脱落结局则更受儿童年龄、出生顺序和母亲教育弱势影响；（3）交互分析显示中度的非加性结构集中在贫困、母亲教育、出生顺序和服务接触变量上；（4）区域层面，所有15个区域-结局单元格的Macro-F1均有改善；（5）邦级层面，平均增益为正，但少数类检测不一致，主要贡献是局部化异质性驱动因素和交互对的定位。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了儿童免疫不足并非单一过程，而是存在"从未接种"与"接种后脱落"两种不同风险特征；揭示了非加性风险结构在理解免疫行为中的重要性，超越了传统加性回归的表征能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度不同地理层面的免疫干预策略提供了差异化依据：零剂量儿童应重点关注贫困、农村和在家分娩群体；脱落儿童应关注年龄较大、出生顺序靠后、母亲教育水平低的孩子。灵活的建模方法有助于定位异质性驱动因素，而非单纯追求算法优越性。

title: Beyond Real Options: When Is Valuation under the Real-World Measure Arbitrage-Free?
affiliations: University of Wuppertal and Ampega Asset Management GmbH

detail.title: Beyond Real Options: When Is Valuation under the Real-World Measure Arbitrage-Free?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper reflects only the authors’ personal opinions and does not necessarily represent the views of the companies with which they are affiliated. The authors have no conflicts of interest to declare that are relevant to the content of this article.

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces a unified arbitrage-free framework that links real-world expectations to risk-neutral valuation. We incorporate valuation under the real-world measure into the standard risk-neutral pricing paradigm and extend it to general contingent claims, deriving closed-form representations for certainty equivalents and risk-adjusted discount rates. 

Within this setting, we show that the traditional discounted cash flow (DCF) method emerges as a special case of arbitrage-free valuation under the real-world measure and is valid only for payoff structures that are linear in the numéraire return. For non-linear claims, including but not limited to investments containing real options, standard beta-based discounting is generally inconsistent with arbitrage-free pricing and can induce economically material mispricing.

More broadly, the framework clarifies the conceptual relationships among risk-neutral valuation, pricing kernels, certainty equivalents, and cost-of-capital approaches within a unified theoretical model. It also provides a precise characterization of the conditions under which real-world valuation methods remain consistent with arbitrage-free pricing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的无套利框架，将真实世界预期与风险中性估值联系起来，展示了传统DCF方法仅在线性支付结构下有效，而非线性投资（如实物期权）中使用标准贝塔折现可能导致严重错误定价。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的无套利框架，将真实世界预期度量下的估值与风险中性定价范式相整合，并厘清不同估值方法之间的概念关系？
AI.motivation: 传统DCF方法在实际应用中广泛使用，但其在非线性支付结构（如实物期权）下的有效性缺乏严格的理论基础。标准贝塔折现法可能与无套利定价不一致，导致实质性错误定价，因此需要统一的理论框架来明确其适用条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无套利定价理论、真实世界度量与风险中性度量转换、定价核（pricing kernel）、确定性等价、风险调整折现率。
AI.method: 理论推导：在无套利框架下，将真实世界度量下的估值纳入标准风险中性定价范式，推导一般或有索赔的确定性等价和风险调整折现率的闭式表达。
AI.findings: (1) 传统DCF方法是真实世界度量下无套利估值的特例，仅当支付结构对标量收益呈线性时成立；(2) 对于非线性支付结构（如实物期权投资），标准贝塔折现法与无套利定价不一致，可能产生实质性的错误定价；(3) 该框架统一了风险中性估值、定价核、确定性等价和资本成本方法之间的概念关系。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 构建了连接真实世界预期与风险中性估值的统一无套利框架；(2) 精确刻画了真实世界估值方法与无套利定价保持一致的充分条件；(3) 揭示了传统DCF方法的理论局限性，拓展了或有索赔定价的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为实务中使用DCF方法提供了严格的理论适用边界，帮助避免在非线性投资中误用；(2) 为含有实物期权的投资项目提供了更准确的定价指导；(3) 有助于实务工作者理解不同估值方法之间的内在联系及选择依据。

title: The Sisyphean Pursuit of Evidence for Poverty Traps
affiliations: Northwestern University,  and Northwestern University

detail.title: The Sisyphean Pursuit of Evidence for Poverty Traps
detail.abstract:
Much of development economics, both micro and macro, posits theories and explores the empirics of poverty traps. A common theory centers around asset-threshold poverty traps in which marginal returns to capital increase sharply over a certain threshold and financial markets are incomplete. This combination leads households above this threshold to prosper while those below continuously fall back, trapped in poverty. Yet in economics, as best as we can tell, far more papers assume such thresholds than empirically demonstrate them. In a key recent exception, Balboni et al. (2022) (hereinafter “BBBGH”) argues that data from Bangladesh identifies clear evidence of such a threshold at slightly above the cost of a cow for recent recipients of a big push transfer program. We apply this analysis to data from seven other similar programs in low-income countries and find no evidence of an asset-threshold poverty trap. We then return to BBBGH and argue that their data do not support the identification of a poverty trap, with the point of disagreement being a log-transformation challenge and a potential geographic confound. In long-term representative rural panel data from Bangladesh and Ghana we find no evidence of divergence away from any particular threshold. While the threshold theory is undoubtedly true for some households, we argue that the pursuit of clear evidence of an asset-threshold poverty trap for a broad population is likely an aspirational goal rendered unachievable by the intersection of a multitude of possible mechanisms as well as heterogeneous agents.

AI.tldr: 本文对资产门槛贫困陷阱理论进行了大规模实证复现检验，发现该理论在多个发展中国家的项目中缺乏证据支持，并对一篇标志性论文（Balboni et al., 2022）的方法论提出质疑，认为门槛识别存在对数变换和地理混杂问题。
AI.research_question: 资产门槛贫困陷阱（asset-threshold poverty trap）是否在低收入国家的实证数据中得到支持？
AI.motivation: 大量发展经济学论文假设存在资产门槛贫困陷阱，但鲜有研究能实证证明其存在。本文旨在系统检验这一理论的普遍性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产门槛贫困陷阱理论：当资本边际回报在某一阈值以上急剧上升，且金融市场不完善时，高于阈值的家庭得以繁荣，低于阈值的家庭则持续陷入贫困。
AI.method: 将BBBGH（2022）的分析方法应用于7个其他低收入国家的类似大推动转移支付项目数据；重新审视BBBGH原始数据，指出对数变换和地理混杂等问题；利用孟加拉国和加纳的长期代表性农村面板数据进行验证。
AI.findings: 1）在7个其他项目中未发现资产门槛贫困陷阱的证据；2）BBBGH的数据本身不支持门槛识别，存在对数变换争议和潜在地理混杂因素；3）长期面板数据中未发现围绕某一特定阈值的分化趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 对资产门槛贫困陷阱理论进行了迄今为止最大规模的跨项目复现检验，对该理论的普遍适用性提出重大质疑。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者，基于单一门槛的大推动干预策略可能缺乏广泛实证基础；贫困干预应关注异质性和多机制。
